quote: 高温养殖组雌雄鳜肝脏脂滴的相对面积总体呈现出先上升后下降的变化趋势(图 4)。
statement: 在高温养殖条件下，雌雄鳜肝脏脂滴的相对面积总体呈现先上升后下降的趋势。
text_zh: 在高温养殖条件下，雌雄鳜肝脏脂滴的相对面积总体呈现先上升后下降的趋势。
text_en: Under high-temperature farming conditions, the relative area of lipid droplets in the livers of male and female mandarin fish generally showed a trend of first increasing and then decreasing.

quote: 在35℃养殖条件下, 雄鳜肝脏脂滴的相对面积较雌鳜也显著升高(P<0.05), 对其肝脏TG含量测定, 发现变化趋势与脂滴的相对面积变化趋势一致, 在35℃条件下, 雄鳜肝脏TG含量也显著高于雌鳜(图 4; P<0.05)。
statement: 在35℃养殖条件下，雄鳜肝脏脂滴相对面积和甘油三酯（TG）含量均显著高于雌鳜。
text_zh: 在35℃养殖条件下，雄鳜肝脏脂滴相对面积和甘油三酯（TG）含量均显著高于雌鳜。
text_en: Under 35°C farming conditions, the relative area of liver lipid droplets and triglyceride (TG) content in male mandarin fish were both significantly higher than those in female mandarin fish.
outcome: 性别二态性/肝脏脂质代谢

quote: 发现在35℃养殖条件下, 与雌鳜相比, 雄鳜脂肪合成基因表达降低, 但无显著性差异(P>0.05), 脂肪β氧化基因显著升高(P<0.05), 糖异生基因表达显著升高(P<0.05), 胰岛素原编码基因ins基因升高, 但无显著性差异(P>0.05; 图 5)。
statement: 在35℃养殖条件下，与雌鳜相比，雄鳜脂肪β氧化基因和糖异生基因表达显著升高，而脂肪合成基因和胰岛素原编码基因表达虽呈降低或升高趋势但无显著差异。
text_zh: 在35℃养殖条件下，与雌鳜相比，雄鳜脂肪β氧化基因和糖异生基因表达显著升高，而脂肪合成基因和胰岛素原编码基因表达虽呈降低或升高趋势但无显著差异。
text_en: Under 35°C rearing conditions, compared with female mandarin fish, the expression of fatty acid beta-oxidation genes and gluconeogenesis genes in male mandarin fish was significantly increased, while the expression of lipogenesis genes and proinsulin-coding genes showed a trend of decrease or increase but no significant difference.

quote: 如图 6所示, 与对照组相比, 高温养殖雌雄鳜肝脏SOD、CAT和MDA含量发生了显著变化。
statement: 与对照组相比，高温养殖导致雌雄鳜肝脏超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）和丙二醛（MDA）含量发生显著变化。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，高温养殖导致雌雄鳜肝脏超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）和丙二醛（MDA）含量发生显著变化。
text_en: Compared with the control group, high-temperature farming caused significant changes in the contents of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and malondialdehyde (MDA) in the livers of male and female mandarin fish.

quote: 雌鳜SOD和CAT活力整体上呈现下降的趋势, MDA含量也相应显著升高(P<0.05), 在36℃时达到最大值,
statement: 高温养殖下，雌鳜肝脏SOD和CAT活力整体呈下降趋势，MDA含量显著升高并在36℃时达到最大值。
text_zh: 高温养殖下，雌鳜肝脏SOD和CAT活力整体呈下降趋势，MDA含量显著升高并在36℃时达到最大值。
text_en: Under high-temperature farming, the liver SOD and CAT activities of female mandarin fish generally showed a decreasing trend, while MDA content increased significantly and reached its maximum at 36°C.

quote: 雄鳜CAT活力和MDA含量变化趋势与雌鳜一致, 但SOD活力随着温度的升高而显著上升(P<0.05)。
statement: 高温养殖下，雄鳜肝脏CAT活力和MDA含量变化趋势与雌鳜一致，但SOD活力随温度升高显著上升。
text_zh: 高温养殖下，雄鳜肝脏CAT活力和MDA含量变化趋势与雌鳜一致，但SOD活力随温度升高显著上升。
text_en: Under high-temperature farming, the trends in liver catalase (CAT) activity and malondialdehyde (MDA) content in male mandarin fish were consistent with those in females, but superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity increased significantly with rising temperature.

quote: 高温养殖雌雄鳜肝脏热休克蛋白、解偶联蛋白及抗氧化相关基因的相对表达量均有显著变化, 且与养殖的温度相关。
statement: 高温养殖导致雌雄鳜肝脏中热休克蛋白、解偶联蛋白及抗氧化相关基因的相对表达量发生显著变化，且这种变化与养殖温度相关。
text_zh: 高温养殖导致雌雄鳜肝脏中热休克蛋白、解偶联蛋白及抗氧化相关基因的相对表达量发生显著变化，且这种变化与养殖温度相关。
text_en: High-temperature farming caused significant changes in the relative expression levels of heat shock protein, uncoupling protein, and antioxidant-related genes in the livers of both male and female mandarin fish, and these changes were related to the farming temperature.

quote: 由图 7可知, 高温养殖对雌鳜肝脏hsp70、hsp90、ucp2、sod和cat基因的相对表达量有显著影响。
statement: 高温养殖对雌鳜肝脏hsp70、hsp90、ucp2、sod和cat基因的相对表达量有显著影响。
text_zh: 高温养殖对雌鳜肝脏hsp70、hsp90、ucp2、sod和cat基因的相对表达量有显著影响。
text_en: High-temperature farming had a significant effect on the relative expression levels of hsp70, hsp90, ucp2, sod and cat genes in the liver of female mandarin fish.

quote: 与对照组雌鳜相比, 随着温度的升高, hsp70和hsp90基因相对表达量先降低后升高, 在35℃时达最低值, 整体上呈显著下降趋势, 而
statement: 与对照组相比，随着温度升高，雌鳜肝脏hsp70和hsp90基因相对表达量先降后升，在35℃时达到最低值，整体呈显著下降趋势。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，随着温度升高，雌鳜肝脏hsp70和hsp90基因相对表达量先降后升，在35℃时达到最低值，整体呈显著下降趋势。
text_en: Compared with the control group, as temperature increased, the relative expression levels of hsp70 and hsp90 genes in the liver of female mandarin fish first decreased and then increased, reaching the lowest value at 35°C, showing an overall significant downward trend.

quote: 在实验开始前, 鳜幼鱼在室内养殖缸(60 cm×30 cm×35 cm)中, 采用循环水养殖系统暂养14d, 水温维持在(28±0.2)℃, 光暗比1﹕1, 暂养期间及实验期间以适口的鲮鱼苗为饵料, 每天投喂1次, 每次投喂的鲮鱼苗数量为实验鳜鱼苗数量的5倍。
statement: 实验前鳜幼鱼在循环水系统中暂养，维持特定水温、光照和投喂频率。
text_zh: 实验前鳜幼鱼在循环水系统中暂养，维持特定水温、光照和投喂频率。
text_en: Before the experiment, juvenile mandarin fish were held in a recirculating aquaculture system, maintaining specific water temperature, light, and feeding frequency.

quote: 再结合前人研究发现25—35℃是鳜的“最适温度范围”
statement: 前人研究指出25-35℃是鳜的最适温度范围。
text_zh: 前人研究指出25-35℃是鳜的最适温度范围。
text_en: Previous studies have indicated that 25-35°C is the optimal temperature range for mandarin fish.

quote: 在实验开始前对各处理组以1℃/12h的升温速率逐步升温, 待升至预设温度时, 开始实验。
statement: 实验开始前采用1℃/12h的缓慢升温速率达到预设温度。
text_zh: 实验开始前采用1℃/12h的缓慢升温速率达到预设温度。
text_en: Before the experiment started, a slow heating rate of 1°C/12h was used to reach the preset temperature.

quote: 在实验结束时, 对所有实验鳜饥饿处理24h
statement: 实验结束采集样品前，对鳜进行了24小时的饥饿处理。
text_zh: 实验结束采集样品前，对鳜进行了24小时的饥饿处理。
text_en: Before collecting samples at the end of the experiment, mandarin fish were subjected to a 24-hour starvation treatment.

quote: No visual response of the mandarin fish has been observed to dead organisms.
statement: 未观察到鳜鱼对死有机体有视觉反应。
text_zh: 未观察到鳜鱼对死有机体有视觉反应。
text_en: No visual response to dead organisms was observed in mandarin fish.

quote: All surgeries were performed under sodium pentobarbital or tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) anesthesia, and every effort was made to minimize the animal suffering.
statement: 所有手术均在戊巴比妥钠或间氨基苯磺酸甲酯（MS-222）麻醉下进行，并尽力减少动物痛苦。
text_zh: 所有手术均在戊巴比妥钠或间氨基苯磺酸甲酯（MS-222）麻醉下进行，并尽力减少动物痛苦。
text_en: All surgeries were performed under anesthesia with sodium pentobarbital or methyl aminobenzoate (MS-222), and every effort was made to minimize animal suffering.
outcome: 手术过程中的动物痛苦

quote: This study was conducted in accordance with the recommendations in the Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals of the National Institutes of Health.
statement: 本研究遵循美国国立卫生研究院《实验动物护理和使用指南》的建议进行。
text_zh: 本研究遵循美国国立卫生研究院《实验动物护理和使用指南》的建议进行。
text_en: This study was conducted in accordance with the recommendations of the US National Institutes of Health Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals.

quote: The protocols include a relative long time of fasting and then continuous refeeding, by which the transcript abundance was assayed over several days or weeks [ 22 , 23 ].
statement: 这些方案包括相对长时间的禁食，然后连续再喂养，通过这种方式在几天或几周内测定转录本丰度。
text_zh: 这些方案包括相对长时间的禁食，然后连续再喂养，通过这种方式在几天或几周内测定转录本丰度。
text_en: These protocols include relatively long periods of fasting followed by continuous refeeding, with transcript abundance measured over days or weeks.

quote: We investigated postprandial changes in juvenile Chinese perch following a single satiating meal (body mass, approximately 100 g) following fasting for 1 week.
statement: 研究调查了经过一周禁食后的幼龄鳜鱼（体重约100克）在单次饱食餐后的变化。
text_zh: 研究调查了经过一周禁食后的幼龄鳜鱼（体重约100克）在单次饱食餐后的变化。
text_en: The study investigated changes in juvenile mandarin fish (body weight about 100 g) after a single satiation meal following one week of fasting.

雌鳜机体在长期高温养殖后已产生免疫疲劳, 体内ROS浓度远
高于抗氧化系统调节阈值, 导致sod和cat基因表达
量的显著降低
statement: 长期高温养殖使雌鳜产生免疫疲劳，因ROS浓度过高导致sod和cat基因表达量显著降低。
text_zh: 长期高温养殖使雌鳜产生免疫疲劳，因ROS浓度过高导致sod和cat基因表达量显著降低。
text_en: Long-term high-temperature farming causes immune fatigue in female mandarin fish, with significantly reduced expression of sod and cat genes due to excessively high ROS concentrations.

quote:
雄鳜体内抗氧化系统调节能力较
强, 在体内ROS浓度增加时, 通过提高sod基因的表
达量以降低ROS含量, 维持机体平衡
statement: 雄鳜通过提高sod基因表达量来降低ROS含量以维持机体平衡，显示其较强的抗氧化调节能力。
text_zh: 雄鳜通过提高sod基因表达量来降低ROS含量以维持机体平衡，显示其较强的抗氧化调节能力。
text_en: Male Chinese perch reduce ROS content by increasing sod gene expression to maintain body balance, showing strong antioxidant regulation ability.

如果胁迫强度增大, 雄鳜将会与雌鳜一样, 产生免
疫疲劳
statement: 雄鳜在36℃时sod基因表达量显著低于35℃，预示若胁迫增强将产生免疫疲劳。
text_zh: 雄鳜在36℃时sod基因表达量显著低于35℃，预示若胁迫增强将产生免疫疲劳。
text_en: The expression level of the sod gene in male mandarin fish was significantly lower at 36°C than at 35°C, suggesting that immune fatigue would occur if stress intensified.
outcome: 热应激极限与免疫疲劳

雌雄鳜肝
脏hsp70和hsp90基因表达量随着养殖温度的升高,

养殖已超过机体自我保护范围, 引起hsp70和hsp90
基因表达量急剧下调。
statement: 随着养殖温度升高，雌雄鳜肝脏hsp70和hsp90基因表达量整体呈显著下降趋势，可能因超过机体自我保护范围所致。
text_zh: 随着养殖温度升高，雌雄鳜肝脏hsp70和hsp90基因表达量整体呈显著下降趋势，可能因超过机体自我保护范围所致。
text_en: As the farming temperature increased, the expression levels of hsp70 and hsp90 genes in the livers of male and female mandarin fish showed an overall significant downward trend, possibly due to exceeding the body's self-protection range.
outcome: 热休克蛋白表达与保护机制

quote:
在长期高温养殖后, 雌雄鳜ucp2基因表达量均显著
下降, 表明雌雄鳜肝脏线粒体可能受损。
statement: 长期高温养殖后，雌雄鳜ucp2基因表达量显著下降，表明肝脏线粒体可能受损。
text_zh: 长期高温养殖后，雌雄鳜ucp2基因表达量显著下降，表明肝脏线粒体可能受损。
text_en: After long-term high-temperature farming, the expression levels of the ucp2 gene in male and female mandarin fish decreased significantly, indicating that liver mitochondria may be damaged.

著升高, 肝脏胰岛素基因、糖异生基因和脂肪分解
基因表达升高, 表明35℃养殖可以更显著的增加雄
性脂肪分解
statement: 35℃养殖条件下，雄鳜SOD活性及基因表达升高，且肝脏相关代谢基因表达升高，增加了雄性脂肪分解。
text_zh: 35℃养殖条件下，雄鳜SOD活性及基因表达升高，且肝脏相关代谢基因表达升高，增加了雄性脂肪分解。
text_en: Under 35°C farming conditions, SOD activity and gene expression in male mandarin fish increased, and the expression of liver-related metabolic genes increased, enhancing male fat breakdown.

quote:
36℃是鳜可耐受的极限高温,
但是其生长水平显著降低, 肝脏脂肪含量显著降低,
说明合成代谢严重受到抑制
statement: 36℃作为极限高温导致鳜生长水平和肝脏脂肪含量显著降低，表明合成代谢受到严重抑制。
text_zh: 36℃作为极限高温导致鳜生长水平和肝脏脂肪含量显著降低，表明合成代谢受到严重抑制。
text_en: 36°C as an extreme high temperature led to a significant decrease in growth level and liver fat content of mandarin fish, indicating that anabolism was severely inhibited.

quote:
故而
在鳜养殖生产过
程中, 特别是全雌鳜的养殖生产, 需要着重强化高温
季节的养殖管控, 防止高水温造成鳜长期处于应激
状态, 引起生长缓慢、代谢障碍和暴发性的病害发生。
statement: 建议强化高温季节养殖管控，以防止高水温导致鳜长期应激、生长缓慢、代谢障碍及病害爆发。
text_zh: 建议强化高温季节养殖管控，以防止高水温导致鳜长期应激、生长缓慢、代谢障碍及病害爆发。
text_en: It is recommended to strengthen aquaculture management during the high-temperature season to prevent long-term stress, slow growth, metabolic disorders, and disease outbreaks in mandarin fish caused by high water temperatures.

quote: The five 1-year-old fishes were euthanized by immersion in water containing 2g L -1 sodium pentobarbital.
statement: 五只一龄鱼通过浸泡在含2克/升戊巴比妥钠的水中被安乐死。
text_zh: 五只一龄鱼通过浸泡在含2克/升戊巴比妥钠的水中被安乐死。
text_en: Five one-year-old fish were euthanized by immersion in water containing 2 g/L sodium pentobarbital.

quote: Two similar sizes of Chinese perch juveniles (average body mass, 100 g) were reared in duplicate net cages (5 × 5 × 2 m), with 50 fish per tank.
statement: 两批大小相似的鳜幼鱼（平均体重100克）在双份网箱（5×5×2米）中饲养，每箱50条鱼。
text_zh: 两批大小相似的鳜幼鱼（平均体重100克）在双份网箱（5×5×2米）中饲养，每箱50条鱼。
text_en: Two batches of similar-sized mandarin fish juveniles (average body weight 100 g) were reared in duplicate net cages (5×5×2 m), with 50 fish per cage.

quote: The fish were provided a live feed (mud carp Cirrhinus molitorella ; average body weight, 10 g) during 3-week experiments (body weight, 1.5%).
statement: 在为期3周的实验中，鱼类被投喂活饵（泥鲮；平均体重10克），投喂量为体重的1.5%。
text_zh: 在为期3周的实验中，鱼类被投喂活饵（泥鲮；平均体重10克），投喂量为体重的1.5%。
text_en: In a 3-week experiment, fish were fed live bait (mud carp; average body weight 10 g) at a rate of 1.5% of body weight.

quote: The fish were firstly fasted for 1 week, and then all of the fish were fed a single meal to visual satiation.
statement: 鱼类首先禁食1周，然后所有鱼都被喂食一顿至视觉饱腹。
text_zh: 鱼类首先禁食1周，然后所有鱼都被喂食一顿至视觉饱腹。
text_en: Fish were first fasted for 1 week, then all fish were fed one meal to visual satiety.

quote: The 5 fishes were selected at each sampling point and were euthanized by immersion in water containing 0.2 g·L −1 MS-222.
statement: 在每个采样点选取5条鱼，并通过浸泡在含0.2克/升MS-222的水中进行安乐死。
text_zh: 在每个采样点选取5条鱼，并通过浸泡在含0.2克/升MS-222的水中进行安乐死。
text_en: At each sampling point, 5 fish were selected and euthanized by immersion in water containing 0.2 g/L MS-222.

text_en: The oxygen consumption and oxygen consumption rate of Elopichthys bambusa both increase with rising water temperature.

statement: 鳡鱼单养模式虽然能提高单位面积产量，但在饵料鱼投放的时间、数量和规格控制上存在困难。
text_zh: 鳡鱼单养模式虽然能提高单位面积产量，但在饵料鱼投放的时间、数量和规格控制上存在困难。
text_en: Although the monoculture model of Elopichthys bambusa can increase yield per unit area, there are difficulties in controlling the timing, quantity, and size specifications of bait fish input.

text_zh: 由于鳡鱼具有好斗习性，呼吸室中放入过多的鱼会影响试验结果。
text_en: Because Elopichthys bambaca has an aggressive habit, placing too many fish in the respiration chamber may affect the test results.

quote: for 1 week, the fish were re-feeding a meal after fasting for one week.

text_en: The experimental design included a one-week fasting period for mandarin fish, followed by refeeding with one meal.

quote: At 1 h following the single meal, ATA2 and a H + -coupled amino acid transporter (putative anion transporter, proton-coupled amino acid transporter 1[PAT1]) increased significantly, whereas CD98 decreased.
statement: 单餐喂食后1小时，ATA2和PAT1显著增加，而CD98减少。
text_zh: 单餐喂食后1小时，ATA2和PAT1显著增加，而CD98减少。
outcome: 肌肉组织氨基酸转运体表达动态

quote:
本试验采用
纸鱼和作其饲料的鱼在同一池塘中饲养
, 而且以纸鱼为主
, 不仅可以持续不断地提供纸鱼
充足的适口饲料
, 而且简单易行
, 成本较低
, 效益较高
。
statement: 本试验采用鳜鱼与其饵料鱼同池混养且以鳜鱼为主的饲养方式，能够持续提供充足适口饲料，具有简单易行、成本低、效益高的特点。
text_zh: 本试验采用鳜鱼与其饵料鱼同池混养且以鳜鱼为主的饲养方式，能够持续提供充足适口饲料，具有简单易行、成本低、效益高的特点。
text_en: This trial adopted a rearing method of co-culturing mandarin fish with its bait fish in the same pond, primarily focusing on mandarin fish. This approach can continuously provide sufficient palatable feed and is characterized by simplicity, low cost, and high efficiency.
intervention: Co-culturing with bait fish in same pond
intervention_record: 鳜鱼与饵料鱼同池混养

quote:
娠鱼的饵料系数为7一12
, 即每生长Ik g 纸鱼
, 至少消耗
7 kg 活饲料鱼
, 因此
, 这种饲养方式成本较高
, 虽然单位产量也高
, 但利率较低
。
statement: 鳜鱼饵料系数高达7-12，导致单独投喂活饲料鱼的饲养方式成本高、利润率低。
text_zh: 鳜鱼饵料系数高达7-12，导致单独投喂活饲料鱼的饲养方式成本高、利润率低。
text_en: The feed conversion ratio of mandarin fish is as high as 7-12, resulting in high costs and low profit margins for the feeding method of solely providing live bait fish.

quote: 放鱼结束后即开始投喂适量菜饼和米糠等商品饲料, 主要目的是饲养鲤和螂鱼
statement: 在池塘养殖试验中，放鱼后投喂菜饼和米糠等商品饲料以饲养鲤和鲢鱼。
text_zh: 在池塘养殖试验中，放鱼后投喂菜饼和米糠等商品饲料以饲养鲤和鲢鱼。
text_en: In pond culture trials, commercial feeds such as rapeseed cake and rice bran were fed after stocking to raise common carp and silver carp.

quote: 待鲤细鱼在池塘自然繁殖后, 按常规方法培养其繁殖的鱼苗, 作为纸鱼的饲料来源
statement: 利用池塘内自然繁殖并培养的鲤、鲢鱼苗作为鳡鱼（文中称纸鱼/缎鱼）的饲料来源。
text_zh: 利用池塘内自然繁殖并培养的鲤、鲢鱼苗作为鳡鱼（文中称纸鱼/缎鱼）的饲料来源。
text_en: Using carp and silver carp fry, naturally reproduced and cultured in ponds, as feed for Elopichthys bambusa (referred to in the text as paper fish/satin fish).

quote: 这可能与缎鱼从鱼种到成鱼均以活的鱼虾类为食, 饵料性质变动不大有关
statement: 鳡鱼耗氧率随体重变化不明显的原因可能与其终生以活鱼虾为食、饵料性质稳定有关。
text_zh: 鳡鱼耗氧率随体重变化不明显的原因可能与其终生以活鱼虾为食、饵料性质稳定有关。
text_en: The reason why the oxygen consumption rate of Elopichthys bambusa does not change significantly with body weight may be related to its lifelong feeding on live fish and shrimp, resulting in stable bait properties.

quote: 当呼吸尚未停止 时 , 及时打开进排水管 , 加换新水 , 绝大多数鱼尚可苏醒 , 若不加注新水 , 鱼很快停止呼吸 休克致死
statement: 在呼吸停止前及时换水，大多数缎鱼可苏醒；若不换水，鱼会迅速停止呼吸并休克致死。
text_zh: 在呼吸停止前及时换水，大多数缎鱼可苏醒；若不换水，鱼会迅速停止呼吸并休克致死。
text_en: If the water is changed in time before breathing stops, most ribbon fish can recover; if the water is not changed, the fish will quickly stop breathing and die from shock.

quote: 若不加注新水, 鱼很快停止呼吸休克致死
statement: 如果不加注新水，处于窒息状态的鱼会很快死亡。
text_zh: 如果不加注新水，处于窒息状态的鱼会很快死亡。
text_en: If no new water is added, fish in a state of suffocation will die quickly.

quote: 但是, 可以肯定, 富营养化较严重的水体, 对纸鱼养殖来说是不适宜的
statement: 富营养化严重的水体不适宜养殖鳜鱼。
text_zh: 富营养化严重的水体不适宜养殖鳜鱼。
text_en: Severely eutrophic water bodies are not suitable for farming mandarin fish.

quote: Conventional culture mainly relies on outdoor pond systems and live bait fish feeding, which is associated with high land occupation, low unit yield, unstable bait supply, and increased risk of pathogen transmission from live prey
statement: 传统养殖主要依赖室外池塘系统和活饵鱼投喂，这与高土地占用、低单位产量、饵料供应不稳定以及从活猎物传播病原体的风险增加有关。
text_zh: 传统养殖主要依赖室外池塘系统和活饵鱼投喂，这与高土地占用、低单位产量、饵料供应不稳定以及从活猎物传播病原体的风险增加有关。
text_en: Traditional farming mainly relies on outdoor pond systems and live bait fish feeding, which is associated with high land occupation, low unit yield, unstable feed supply, and an increased risk of pathogen transmission from live prey.
outcome: 疾病风险与养殖稳定性

quote: In addition, pond environments are easily affected by seasons, weather, and external water sources, resulting in unstable water quality and difficulties in standardized management.
statement: 此外，池塘环境容易受到季节、天气和外部水源的影响，导致水质不稳定且难以进行标准化管理。
text_zh: 此外，池塘环境容易受到季节、天气和外部水源的影响，导致水质不稳定且难以进行标准化管理。
text_en: In addition, pond environments are easily affected by seasons, weather, and external water sources, leading to unstable water quality and difficulty in standardized management.
outcome: 水质稳定性与管理难度

quote: RAS is characterized by high-density culture, closed-loop water circulation, stable environmental parameters, and reduced water and land consumption, which can effectively improve production stability and product safety [ 4 ]
statement: RAS以高密度养殖、闭环水循环、稳定的环境参数以及减少水和土地消耗为特征，能有效提高生产稳定性和产品安全性。
text_zh: RAS以高密度养殖、闭环水循环、稳定的环境参数以及减少水和土地消耗为特征，能有效提高生产稳定性和产品安全性。
text_en: RAS is characterized by high-density farming, closed-loop water circulation, stable environmental parameters, and reduced water and land consumption, effectively improving production stability and product safety.
outcome: 生产稳定性与产品安全

quote: During the transition from traditional pond farming to industrial RAS farming, and from live bait to artificial feed, the farming environment and nutrient intake patterns of mandarin fish have undergone profound changes, which may lead to significant changes in their gut microbiota.
statement: 从传统池塘养殖向工业循环水养殖（RAS）的转变，以及从活饵向人工饲料的转变，导致鳜鱼的养殖环境和营养摄入模式发生深刻变化，这可能引起其肠道菌群的显著改变。
text_zh: 从传统池塘养殖向工业循环水养殖（RAS）的转变，以及从活饵向人工饲料的转变，导致鳜鱼的养殖环境和营养摄入模式发生深刻变化，这可能引起其肠道菌群的显著改变。
text_en: The transition from traditional pond farming to industrial recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), and the shift from live bait to artificial feed, leads to profound changes in the farming environment and nutritional intake patterns of mandarin fish, which may cause significant alterations in their gut microbiota.

quote: The aim of this study is to explore how aquaculture environment and feed type affect the structure, diversity, and predictive function of gut microbiota, and to analyze the correlation between environment and dietary choices and gut microbiota.
statement: 本研究旨在探索养殖环境和饲料类型如何影响肠道菌群的结构、多样性和预测功能，并分析环境与饮食选择同肠道菌群之间的相关性。
text_zh: 本研究旨在探索养殖环境和饲料类型如何影响肠道菌群的结构、多样性和预测功能，并分析环境与饮食选择同肠道菌群之间的相关性。
text_en: This study aims to explore how the farming environment and feed type affect the structure, diversity, and predicted functions of gut microbiota, and to analyze the correlations between environmental and dietary choices and gut microbiota.

text_zh: 由于试验过程中不施肥，因此不像一般精养鱼池那样出现严重的池水富营养化。
text_en: Because no fertilizer was applied during the trial, severe eutrophication of the pond water did not occur as it does in typical intensive fish ponds.

quote: 一种是网箱或池塘单养, 人工投喂活鱼作饲料...这种饲养方式成本较高, 虽然单位产量也高, 但利率较低

text_zh: 网箱或池塘单养并人工投喂活鱼作为饲料的方式成本较高，虽然单位产量高，但利润率较低。
text_en: The method of monoculture in cages or ponds with artificial feeding of live fish as feed has high costs; although the unit yield is high, the profit margin is low.

quote: The initial fish size and health status were standardized across all groups.
statement: 所有组的初始鱼体大小和健康状况均进行了标准化。

statement: 在相同的人工饲料条件下，将养殖模式从池塘（CS）切换为工业循环水系统（RAS/GS）会急剧降低肠道微生物多样性并简化群落结构。
text_zh: 在相同的人工饲料条件下，将养殖模式从池塘（CS）切换为工业循环水系统（RAS/GS）会急剧降低肠道微生物多样性并简化群落结构。
text_en: Under the same artificial feed conditions, switching the farming mode from ponds (CS) to industrial recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS/GS) drastically reduces intestinal microbial diversity and simplifies community structure.

quote: GS exhibited a sharp rise in Fusobacteriota, with Cetobacterium (64.94%) becoming the single dominant genus.

quote: Live bait fish were freshly obtained from the same source throughout the experiment, and fed to the CE group twice daily to apparent satiation.
statement: 活饵鱼在整个实验中从同一来源新鲜获取，并以表观饱食度每天两次喂食CE组。
text_zh: 活饵鱼在整个实验中从同一来源新鲜获取，并以表观饱食度每天两次喂食CE组。
text_en: Live bait fish were freshly obtained from the same source throughout the experiment and fed to the CE group twice daily at apparent satiation.

quote: Fish in the CS and GS groups were fed the artificial diet twice daily
statement: CS组和GS组的鱼每天两次喂食人工饲料。
text_zh: CS组和GS组的鱼每天两次喂食人工饲料。
text_en: Fish in the CS and GS groups were fed artificial feed twice a day.

quote: industrial recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) and artificial compound feed have become two core directions of technological upgrading
statement: 工业循环水养殖系统（RAS）和人工配合饲料已成为技术升级的两个核心方向。
text_zh: 工业循环水养殖系统（RAS）和人工配合饲料已成为技术升级的两个核心方向。
text_en: Industrial recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) and artificial formulated feeds have become the two core directions of technological upgrading.
intervention_record: 循环水养殖与人工配合饲料
outcome: 生产稳定性与产品安全

quote: artificial compound feed can eliminate dependence on live bait fish, standardize nutrition supply, reduce disease transmission risks, and facilitate large-scale industrial management [ 5 ]
statement: 人工配合饲料可以消除对活饵鱼的依赖，标准化营养供应，降低疾病传播风险，并便于大规模工业化管理。
text_zh: 人工配合饲料可以消除对活饵鱼的依赖，标准化营养供应，降低疾病传播风险，并便于大规模工业化管理。
text_en: Artificial formulated feed can eliminate dependence on live bait fish, standardize nutritional supply, reduce the risk of disease transmission, and facilitate large-scale industrial management.

quote: The feasibility and advantages of RAS and artificial feed have been verified in many cultured fish species, such as common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ) [ 6 ], shrimp ( Penaeus vannamei ) [ 7 ], and rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) [ 8 ], Micropterus salmoides [ 9 ] as well as Salmo salar [ 10 ].
statement: RAS和人工饲料的可行性和优势已在许多养殖鱼类中得到验证，如鲤鱼、南美白对虾、虹鳟、大口黑鲈和大西洋鲑。
text_zh: RAS和人工饲料的可行性和优势已在许多养殖鱼类中得到验证，如鲤鱼、南美白对虾、虹鳟、大口黑鲈和大西洋鲑。
text_en: The feasibility and advantages of RAS and artificial feed have been verified in many farmed fish species, such as common carp, whiteleg shrimp, rainbow trout, largemouth bass, and Atlantic salmon.

population.species: Cyprinus carpio; Penaeus vannamei; Oncorhynchus mykiss; Micropterus salmoides; Salmo salar

intervention_record: 循环水养殖与人工配合饲料

quote: However, their comprehensive effects on the physiological status and intestinal health of mandarin fish remain to be systematically elucidated, especially the associations of combined environment and diet with gut microbial homeostasis.
statement: 然而，它们对鳜鱼生理状态和肠道健康的综合影响仍有待系统阐明，特别是环境与饮食联合因素与肠道微生物稳态之间的关联。
text_zh: 然而，它们对鳜鱼生理状态和肠道健康的综合影响仍有待系统阐明，特别是环境与饮食联合因素与肠道微生物稳态之间的关联。
text_en: However, their combined effects on the physiological status and gut health of mandarin fish remain to be systematically elucidated, particularly the association between combined environmental and dietary factors and gut microbial homeostasis.
intervention_record: 循环水养殖与人工配合饲料

quote: This study analyzed the gut microbial diversity and community composition of mandarin fish reared under different culture systems and feeding regimens.
statement: 本研究分析了在不同养殖系统和饲喂方案下饲养的鳜鱼的肠道微生物多样性和群落组成。
text_zh: 本研究分析了在不同养殖系统和饲喂方案下饲养的鳜鱼的肠道微生物多样性和群落组成。
text_en: This study analyzed the gut microbial diversity and community composition of mandarin fish raised under different farming systems and feeding regimes.
intervention: Different farming modes and feeding regimes
intervention_record: 不同养殖模式与饲喂方案
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性与群落组成

quote: 在进行耗氧率测试结束后 , 紧接着进行窒息点的测定 , 当关闭进 水管数小时后 , 随水中溶氧量的降低 , 缓鱼首先表现出呼吸频率加快
statement: 在耗氧率测试后测定窒息点，关闭进水管导致溶氧降低时，缎鱼首先表现为呼吸频率加快。
text_zh: 在耗氧率测试后测定窒息点，关闭进水管导致溶氧降低时，缎鱼首先表现为呼吸频率加快。
text_en: After the oxygen consumption rate test, the asphyxiation point was determined. When closing the water inlet pipe caused dissolved oxygen to decrease, the satinfish first exhibited an increased respiratory frequency.

quote: 在常态情况下 , 姗鱼 的呼吸频率约为50 一60 次/m in , 接近窒息状态时 , 溶解氧约为lm g/L 左右 , 其呼吸频率 为10 一110 次/m in , 此时鱼上下窜动 , 以后呼吸频率逐渐下降 , 失去正常平游活动能力 , 侧卧或腹面向上 , 休克前作垂死挣扎数次 , 最后呈昏迷状态 , 侧卧水底层
statement: 常态下缎鱼呼吸频率约50-60次/min；接近窒息（溶氧约1mg/L）时呼吸频率增至10-110次/min，出现上下窜动、失去平衡、侧卧、挣扎及昏迷等症状。
text_zh: 常态下缎鱼呼吸频率约50-60次/min；接近窒息（溶氧约1mg/L）时呼吸频率增至10-110次/min，出现上下窜动、失去平衡、侧卧、挣扎及昏迷等症状。
text_en: Under normal conditions, the breathing frequency of satinfish is about 50-60 breaths/min; when approaching suffocation (dissolved oxygen about 1 mg/L), the breathing frequency increases to 10-110 breaths/min, and symptoms such as vertical darting, loss of balance, lying on side, struggling, and coma appear.

quote: This distribution feature presents a correlation with the nutrient composition of artificial feed, indicating that the protein ingredients in formulated feed can match the nutritional demands of mandarin fish.
statement: 这种分布特征与人工饲料的营养成分呈相关关系，表明配合饲料中的蛋白质成分可以满足鳜鱼的营养需求。
text_zh: 这种分布特征与人工饲料的营养成分呈相关关系，表明配合饲料中的蛋白质成分可以满足鳜鱼的营养需求。
text_en: This distribution characteristic is correlated with the nutritional composition of artificial feed, indicating that the protein component in compound feed can meet the nutritional requirements of mandarin fish.

quote: The diverse microbial community corresponding to live bait feeding may help the host adapt to the constantly changing environmental fluctuations in the pond.
statement: 对应于活饵喂养的多样化微生物群落可能有助于宿主适应池塘中不断变化的环境波动。
text_zh: 对应于活饵喂养的多样化微生物群落可能有助于宿主适应池塘中不断变化的环境波动。
text_en: The diverse microbial community corresponding to live feed feeding may help the host adapt to changing environmental fluctuations in ponds.

quote: This indicates that the CS group’s artificially formulated feed has a balanced nutritional ratio.
statement: 这表明CS组的人工配合饲料具有均衡的营养比例。
text_zh: 这表明CS组的人工配合饲料具有均衡的营养比例。
text_en: This indicates that the artificial compound feed in the CS group has a balanced nutritional ratio.

quote: The gut microbiota cultured in RAS may reduce the risk of this disease, but the significant simplification of microbial community structure may also reduce interspecies competition and immune regulatory stimulation among different microorganisms.
statement: 循环水养殖系统（RAS）中培养的肠道微生物群可能降低疾病风险，但微生物群落结构的显著简化也可能减少不同微生物之间的种间竞争和免疫调节刺激。
text_zh: 循环水养殖系统（RAS）中培养的肠道微生物群可能降低疾病风险，但微生物群落结构的显著简化也可能减少不同微生物之间的种间竞争和免疫调节刺激。
text_en: The gut microbiota cultivated in Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) may reduce disease risk, but the significant simplification of microbial community structure may also reduce interspecies competition among different microbes and immune regulatory stimulation.
counterevidence: 微生物群落结构简化可能减少种间竞争和免疫调节刺激

quote: The above results indicate that within the scope of comparison in this group, the transformation of open ponds to closed factory circulating water significantly reduced the species richness and community uniformity of the gut microbiota of mandarin fish.
statement: 结果表明，在该组比较范围内，从开放池塘转变为封闭工厂循环水显著降低了鳜鱼肠道微生物群的物种丰富度和群落均匀度。
text_zh: 结果表明，在该组比较范围内，从开放池塘转变为封闭工厂循环水显著降低了鳜鱼肠道微生物群的物种丰富度和群落均匀度。
text_en: The results showed that, within the range of comparisons in this group, transitioning from open ponds to closed factory recirculating aquaculture systems significantly reduced the species richness and community evenness of the gut microbiota of mandarin fish.

population.system: 封闭工厂循环水 vs 开放池塘

quote: Within pond systems, replacing live bait with artificial compound feed induced mild shifts in intestinal microbial composition without altering overall community structure.
statement: 在池塘系统中，用人工配合饲料替代活饵会引起肠道微生物组成的轻微变化，但不会改变整体群落结构。
text_zh: 在池塘系统中，用人工配合饲料替代活饵会引起肠道微生物组成的轻微变化，但不会改变整体群落结构。
text_en: In pond systems, replacing live bait with artificial formulated feed causes slight changes in gut microbial composition but does not alter the overall community structure.
intervention: Replacing live bait with artificial feed

quote: When fish are fed the same compound feed, the shift from pond to industrial RAS was accompanied by simplified gut microbial communities, reduced alpha diversity, and dramatic shifts in dominant bacterial taxa, resulting in distinct community separation between the two groups.
statement: 当鱼类喂食相同的配合饲料时，从池塘转向工业循环水养殖系统（RAS）伴随着肠道微生物群落的简化、α多样性的降低以及优势细菌类群的剧烈变化，导致两组之间出现明显的群落分离。
text_zh: 当鱼类喂食相同的配合饲料时，从池塘转向工业循环水养殖系统（RAS）伴随着肠道微生物群落的简化、α多样性的降低以及优势细菌类群的剧烈变化，导致两组之间出现明显的群落分离。
text_en: When fish are fed the same formulated feed, switching from ponds to industrial recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) is accompanied by a simplification of the gut microbial community, a decrease in alpha diversity, and drastic changes in dominant bacterial taxa, resulting in clear community separation between the two groups.
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性与群落结构

quote: Although there is a slight reduction in the number of dominant species, it increases the overall abundance of functional symbiotic bacteria and stabilizes the intestinal microbiota structure.
statement: 尽管优势物种数量略有减少，但增加了功能共生细菌的整体丰度并稳定了肠道微生物群结构。
text_zh: 尽管优势物种数量略有减少，但增加了功能共生细菌的整体丰度并稳定了肠道微生物群结构。
text_en: Although the number of dominant species decreased slightly, it increased the overall abundance of functional symbiotic bacteria and stabilized the gut microbiota structure.
counterevidence: 优势物种数量略有减少

quote: Alpha diversity analysis revealed that CS had higher Chao1, ACE, Shannon and Simpson indices than CE, demonstrating that pond culture combined with artificial feed sustained richer, more balanced intestinal microbiota.
statement: Alpha多样性分析显示CS组的Chao1、ACE、Shannon和Simpson指数高于CE组，表明池塘养殖结合人工饲料维持了更丰富、更平衡的肠道微生物群。
text_zh: Alpha多样性分析显示CS组的Chao1、ACE、Shannon和Simpson指数高于CE组，表明池塘养殖结合人工饲料维持了更丰富、更平衡的肠道微生物群。
text_en: Alpha diversity analysis showed that the Chao1, ACE, Shannon and Simpson indices of the CS group were higher than those of the CE group, indicating that pond farming combined with artificial feed maintained a richer and more balanced gut microbiota.

quote: Beta diversity showed no significant overall community differentiation between CE and CS, indicating that feed substitution exerted weak effects on gut microbiota under identical pond culture conditions.
statement: Beta多样性显示CE和CS之间没有显著的总体群落差异，表明在相同的池塘养殖条件下，饲料替代对肠道微生物群的影响较弱。
text_zh: Beta多样性显示CE和CS之间没有显著的总体群落差异，表明在相同的池塘养殖条件下，饲料替代对肠道微生物群的影响较弱。
text_en: Beta diversity showed no significant overall community difference between CE and CS, indicating that the effect of feed substitution on the gut microbiota was weak under the same pond farming conditions.
intervention: Replacing live bait with artificial feed
outcome: 肠道微生物群群落结构

quote: Most taxa enriched in CS have been reported to support intestinal homeostasis in published literature: Agathobacter is associated with short-chain fatty acid synthesis and host metabolic homeostasis [ 39 , 40 ]; Oscillibacter correlates with cholesterol metabolism and can alleviate inflammatory responses and oxidative stress [ 41 , 42 , 43 ]; UCG-010 has a positive impact on certain specific diseases and is associated with immune and antioxidant functions [ 44 , 45 , 46 ].
statement: 文献报道CS中富集的多数类群支持肠道稳态：Agathobacter与短链脂肪酸合成及宿主代谢稳态相关；Oscillibacter与胆固醇代谢相关并可缓解炎症反应和氧化应激；UCG-010对某些特定疾病有积极影响并与免疫和抗氧化功能相关。
text_zh: 文献报道CS中富集的多数类群支持肠道稳态：Agathobacter与短链脂肪酸合成及宿主代谢稳态相关；Oscillibacter与胆固醇代谢相关并可缓解炎症反应和氧化应激；UCG-010对某些特定疾病有积极影响并与免疫和抗氧化功能相关。
text_en: Literature reports that the majority of enriched taxa in CS support gut homeostasis: Agathobacter is associated with short-chain fatty acid synthesis and host metabolic homeostasis; Oscillibacter is associated with cholesterol metabolism and can alleviate inflammatory responses and oxidative stress; UCG-010 has positive effects on certain specific diseases and is associated with immune and antioxidant functions.

quote: This work illuminated the divergent gut microbial adaptive responses of mandarin fish to feed and aquaculture environment, providing microecological theoretical support for optimizing healthy breeding management of mandarin fish.
statement: 本研究揭示了鳜鱼对饲料和水产养殖环境不同的肠道微生物适应性反应，为优化鳜鱼健康养殖管理提供了微生态学理论支持。
text_zh: 本研究揭示了鳜鱼对饲料和水产养殖环境不同的肠道微生物适应性反应，为优化鳜鱼健康养殖管理提供了微生态学理论支持。
text_en: This study revealed the different gut microbiota adaptive responses of mandarin fish to feed and aquaculture environments, providing microbiological theoretical support for optimizing healthy aquaculture management of mandarin fish.

quote: The results indicated that pond culture supported more diverse gut-microbial members, whereas RAS culture simplified the intestinal-microbial composition of mandarin fish.
statement: 结果表明池塘养殖支持更多样的肠道微生物成员，而循环水养殖简化了鳜鱼的肠道微生物组成。
text_zh: 结果表明池塘养殖支持更多样的肠道微生物成员，而循环水养殖简化了鳜鱼的肠道微生物组成。
text_en: The results showed that pond culture supported more diverse gut microbial members, while recirculating aquaculture systems simplified the gut microbiota composition of Chinese perch.

population.system: 池塘养殖; 循环水养殖系统 (RAS)

quote: When mandarin fish were infected with a sublethal dosage of MRV under a nonpermissive temperature (19 °C) and a permissive temperature (26 °C), all of the fish in the 19 °C group survived and entered the persistent phase of infection, characterized by a very low viral load in white blood cells, whereas some of the fish died of MRV infection in the 26 °C group, and the survival fish then initiated a persistent infection status.
statement: 在19°C非许可温度下感染亚致死剂量MRV的鳜鱼全部存活并进入持续感染期，而在26°C许可温度下部分鳜鱼死亡，幸存鱼随后也进入持续感染状态。
text_zh: 在19°C非许可温度下感染亚致死剂量MRV的鳜鱼全部存活并进入持续感染期，而在26°C许可温度下部分鳜鱼死亡，幸存鱼随后也进入持续感染状态。
text_en: All mandarin fish infected with a sublethal dose of MRV at the non-permitted temperature of 19°C survived and entered a persistent infection phase, whereas some mandarin fish died at the permitted temperature of 26°C, and the surviving fish subsequently also entered a persistent infection state.
outcome: 疾病死亡率与病毒载量

quote: Raising the temperature, vaccination and dexamethasone treatment can reactivate the quiescent MRV to replicate and result in partial mortality.
statement: 升高温度、疫苗接种和地塞米松处理可以重新激活潜伏的MRV使其复制，并导致部分死亡。
text_zh: 升高温度、疫苗接种和地塞米松处理可以重新激活潜伏的MRV使其复制，并导致部分死亡。
text_en: Increasing temperature, vaccination and dexamethasone treatment can reactivate latent MRV to replicate, leading to partial mortality.
intervention: Temperature stress, vaccination and DXMS treatment

quote: The injection of heat-inactivated E. coli can reactivate FV3 in asymptomatic adult frogs and lead to fatal infections
statement: 注射热灭活的大肠杆菌可以重新激活无症状成年青蛙体内的FV3并导致致命感染。
text_zh: 注射热灭活的大肠杆菌可以重新激活无症状成年青蛙体内的FV3并导致致命感染。
text_en: Injection of heat-inactivated E. coli can reactivate FV3 in asymptomatic adult frogs and lead to fatal infection.

quote: Such community variation may be driven by unique abiotic conditions of closed recirculating aquaculture systems.
statement: 这种群落变化可能是由封闭循环水养殖系统的独特非生物条件驱动的。
text_zh: 这种群落变化可能是由封闭循环水养殖系统的独特非生物条件驱动的。
text_en: This community change may be driven by the unique abiotic conditions of recirculating aquaculture systems.
outcome: 环境因素对微生物的影响

quote: The abundance of Aeromonas genus has decreased significantly, and related research reports suggest that some bacteria in aquaculture may have conditional pathogenic potential, leading to diseases [ 48 ].
statement: 气单胞菌属的丰度显著降低，相关研究报告表明，水产养殖中的某些细菌可能具有条件致病潜力，从而导致疾病。
text_zh: 气单胞菌属的丰度显著降低，相关研究报告表明，水产养殖中的某些细菌可能具有条件致病潜力，从而导致疾病。
text_en: The abundance of Aeromonas decreased significantly; related research reports indicate that certain bacteria in aquaculture may have conditional pathogenic potential, leading to disease.

quote: Before the experiment, the mandarin fish were randomly sampled and tested to confirm that they were free of asymptomatic MRV carriers by using qPCR.
statement: 实验前通过qPCR随机抽样检测，确认鳜鱼无无症状MRV携带者。
text_zh: 实验前通过qPCR随机抽样检测，确认鳜鱼无无症状MRV携带者。
text_en: Before the experiment, random sampling testing by qPCR confirmed that mandarin fish had no asymptomatic MRV carriers.

quote: Group I was comprised of 15 fish reared in an aquatic environment with a constant water temperature of 26 °C.
statement: 第一组包含15条鱼，在恒定水温26°C的水生环境中饲养。
text_zh: 第一组包含15条鱼，在恒定水温26°C的水生环境中饲养。
text_en: The first group contained 15 fish, raised in an aquatic environment with a constant water temperature of 26°C.

quote: The tissues of moribund fish from the treatment with temperature stress, vaccination or dexamethasone stimulation were collected and fixed with alcohol–formal acetic (AFA) for IHC analysis as our previous description [ 14 ].
statement: 从温度胁迫、疫苗接种或地塞米松刺激处理后的濒死鱼中采集组织，并用酒精-福尔马林乙酸（AFA）固定以进行免疫组化分析。
text_zh: 从温度胁迫、疫苗接种或地塞米松刺激处理后的濒死鱼中采集组织，并用酒精-福尔马林乙酸（AFA）固定以进行免疫组化分析。
text_en: Tissues were collected from moribund fish after temperature stress, vaccination, or dexamethasone stimulation treatment and fixed with alcohol-formalin-acetic acid (AFA) for immunohistochemical analysis.
intervention: Temperature stress, vaccination and DXMS treatment

quote: th identical specifications were maintained at a temperature of 26 °C and infected with MRV by i.p. injection with 10 6.5 TCID 50 /0.1 mL/fish.
statement: 鱼在26°C下通过腹腔注射MRV病毒进行感染。
text_zh: 鱼在26°C下通过腹腔注射MRV病毒进行感染。
text_en: Fish were infected with MRV virus via intraperitoneal injection at 26°C.

quote: A qPCR was conducted to confirm that the survival fishes had entered into a persistent infection status, and then vaccination and DXMS treatments were exerted.
statement: 通过qPCR确认幸存鱼进入持续感染状态后，进行了疫苗接种和DXMS处理。
text_zh: 通过qPCR确认幸存鱼进入持续感染状态后，进行了疫苗接种和DXMS处理。
text_en: After qPCR confirmed that surviving fish had entered a persistent infection state, vaccination and DXMS treatment were performed.
intervention: Temperature stress, vaccination and DXMS treatment

quote: During these treatments, tissues from the moribund fish were sampled for viral load measurements.
statement: 在治疗期间，从濒死鱼中采集组织以测量病毒载量。
text_zh: 在治疗期间，从濒死鱼中采集组织以测量病毒载量。
text_en: During the treatment period, tissues were collected from moribund fish to measure viral load.

quote: Subsequently, mass mortalities ensue within 3–10 days, with an accumulative mortality of 50% [ 14 , 15 ].
statement: 随后在3-10天内发生大规模死亡，累积死亡率为50%。
text_zh: 随后在3-10天内发生大规模死亡，累积死亡率为50%。
text_en: Subsequently, mass mortality occurred within 3-10 days, with a cumulative mortality rate of 50%.

quote: In contrast, the chronic phase of infection is characterized by lethargy, anorexia, abnormal swimming and impaired coordination, and can persist for up to 5 months [ 14 ].
statement: 相比之下，慢性感染阶段以嗜睡、厌食、异常游泳和协调受损为特征，可持续长达5个月。
text_zh: 相比之下，慢性感染阶段以嗜睡、厌食、异常游泳和协调受损为特征，可持续长达5个月。
text_en: In contrast, the chronic infection phase is characterized by lethargy, anorexia, abnormal swimming, and impaired coordination, lasting up to 5 months.

quote: During chronic infection, most of the surviving fish become emaciated and deformed due to long-term anorexia or abnormal feeding, and then lose their breeding value.
statement: 在慢性感染期间，大多数存活的鱼因长期厌食或异常摄食而变得消瘦和畸形，从而失去育种价值。
text_zh: 在慢性感染期间，大多数存活的鱼因长期厌食或异常摄食而变得消瘦和畸形，从而失去育种价值。
text_en: During chronic infection, most surviving fish become emaciated and deformed due to prolonged anorexia or abnormal feeding, thereby losing breeding value.

quote: Especially during chronic infection, very low numbers of copies of viral genomic DNA were detected using real-time quantitative PCR (qRT-PCR), but not by conventional PCR, using the visceral organs such as the spleen, liver and kidney.
statement: 特别是在慢性感染期间，使用内脏器官（如脾脏、肝脏和肾脏）通过实时定量PCR检测到极少量的病毒基因组DNA拷贝，但常规PCR未能检测到。
text_zh: 特别是在慢性感染期间，使用内脏器官（如脾脏、肝脏和肾脏）通过实时定量PCR检测到极少量的病毒基因组DNA拷贝，但常规PCR未能检测到。
text_en: Especially during chronic infection, very small amounts of viral genomic DNA copies were detected in visceral organs (such as the spleen, liver, and kidney) by real-time quantitative PCR, but not by conventional PCR.
limitations: 常规PCR无法检测到低载量病毒

quote: During MRV-PCI, sporadic death, but not mass mortality, are the major events.
statement: 在MRV持续隐性感染期间，主要事件是零星死亡，而非大规模死亡。
text_zh: 在MRV持续隐性感染期间，主要事件是零星死亡，而非大规模死亡。
text_en: During MRV persistent covert infection, the main event is sporadic deaths rather than mass mortality.

quote: Until recently, an inactivated ISKNV vaccine with an absolute protection effect of 90% was developed and officially licensed for a commercial application in mainland China
statement: 一种灭活ISKNV疫苗已开发并在中国大陆获得商业应用许可，其绝对保护效果为90%。
text_zh: 一种灭活ISKNV疫苗已开发并在中国大陆获得商业应用许可，其绝对保护效果为90%。
text_en: An inactivated ISKNV vaccine has been developed and licensed for commercial use in mainland China, with an absolute protection rate of 90%.

quote: The inactivated ISKNV vaccine also showed the same high efficacy in Asia seabass Lates calcarifer and spotted seabass L. maculatus against various genotypes of ISKNV/RSIV isolates in ISKNV species
statement: 灭活ISKNV疫苗在亚洲鲈和斑点鲈中针对ISKNV物种内的各种基因型分离株也显示出同样的高效力。
text_zh: 灭活ISKNV疫苗在亚洲鲈和斑点鲈中针对ISKNV物种内的各种基因型分离株也显示出同样的高效力。
text_en: The inactivated ISKNV vaccine also showed similarly high efficacy against various genotype isolates within the ISKNV species in Asian sea bass and spotted sea bass.

population.species: 亚洲鲈 (Asia seabass), 斑点鲈 (spotted seabass)

quote: As a result, either the inactivated vaccine or non-lethal active virus exposure could elicit robust immune protection against infection or re-infection with virulent ISKNV/RSIV
statement: 因此，无论是灭活疫苗还是非致死性活性病毒暴露都能引发对强毒力ISKNV/RSIV感染或再感染的强大免疫保护。
text_zh: 因此，无论是灭活疫苗还是非致死性活性病毒暴露都能引发对强毒力ISKNV/RSIV感染或再感染的强大免疫保护。
text_en: Therefore, both inactivated vaccines and non-lethal live virus exposure can elicit strong immune protection against virulent ISKNV/RSIV infection or reinfection.

population.species: 鳜鱼 (implied by context of ISKNV/RSIV)

intervention: Inactivated vaccine or non-lethal live virus exposure
intervention_record: 灭活疫苗或非致死活病毒暴露

quote: Additionally, the non-lethal active MRV exposure could cause long-term MRV-PCI
statement: 此外，非致死性活性MRV暴露可能导致长期的MRV相关持续性感染（MRV-PCI）。
text_zh: 此外，非致死性活性MRV暴露可能导致长期的MRV相关持续性感染（MRV-PCI）。
text_en: In addition, non-lethal active MRV exposure may lead to long-term MRV-related persistent infection (MRV-PCI).

population.species: 鳜鱼 (implied by context of MRV)

quote: Prior to infection, the individual mandarin fish in group II were labeled as M1~M20 by the injection of a microchip into the back muscle.
statement: 在感染前，通过向背部肌肉注射微芯片对第二组的鳜鱼个体进行标记。
text_zh: 在感染前，通过向背部肌肉注射微芯片对第二组的鳜鱼个体进行标记。
text_en: Before infection, individuals of the second group of mandarin fish were tagged by injecting microchips into the dorsal muscle.

quote: Following two weeks of acclimatization, all of the fish were challenged by intraperitoneal injection (i.p.) with MRV-ZQ17 at 10 6.5 TCID 50 /0.1 mL/fish.
statement: 经过两周的适应后，所有鱼均通过腹腔注射（i.p.）以每鱼0.1毫升含10^6.5 TCID50的MRV-ZQ17病毒株进行攻毒。
text_zh: 经过两周的适应后，所有鱼均通过腹腔注射（i.p.）以每鱼0.1毫升含10^6.5 TCID50的MRV-ZQ17病毒株进行攻毒。
text_en: After two weeks of acclimation, all fish were challenged by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection with the MRV-ZQ17 virus strain at a dose of 0.1 mL per fish containing 10^6.5 TCID50.

quote: The fish were fed with a daily diet of live commercial bait fish.
statement: 这些鱼每天喂食活的商品饵料鱼。
text_zh: 这些鱼每天喂食活的商品饵料鱼。
text_en: These fish are fed live commercial baitfish daily.

quote: To determine whether the quiescent MRV can be reactivated by raising the temperature stress, at 38 days post-infection (dpi), the water temperature of group II was incrementally increased from 19 °C to 26 °C, with a gradual rate of 1 °C per 2 days, ultimately maintaining a constant temperature of 26 °C until the end of the experiment.
statement: 为了确定潜伏的MRV是否可以通过升温应激被重新激活，在感染后第38天，将第二组的水温从19°C逐渐升高至26°C，速率为每2天升高1°C，并最终保持26°C恒温直至实验结束。
text_zh: 为了确定潜伏的MRV是否可以通过升温应激被重新激活，在感染后第38天，将第二组的水温从19°C逐渐升高至26°C，速率为每2天升高1°C，并最终保持26°C恒温直至实验结束。
text_en: To determine whether latent MRV could be reactivated by heat stress, on day 38 post-infection, the water temperature of the second group was gradually increased from 19°C to 26°C at a rate of 1°C every 2 days, and finally maintained at a constant 26°C until the end of the experiment.
outcome: 环境胁迫与疾病再激活

quote: the blood samples were obtained from the surviving fish through the tail vein following anesthesia for t
statement: 在麻醉后，通过尾静脉从存活的鱼中采集血液样本。
text_zh: 在麻醉后，通过尾静脉从存活的鱼中采集血液样本。
text_en: After anesthesia, blood samples were collected from live fish via the caudal vein.

quote: Two groups of mandarin fish reared in two different temperatures were challenged with a sublethal dose (10 6.5 TCID 50 /fish) of MRV-ZQ17.
statement: 两组在两种不同温度下饲养的鳜鱼被以亚致死剂量（10^6.5 TCID50/尾）的MRV-ZQ17病毒攻击。
text_zh: 两组在两种不同温度下饲养的鳜鱼被以亚致死剂量（10^6.5 TCID50/尾）的MRV-ZQ17病毒攻击。
text_en: Two groups of mandarin fish reared at two different temperatures were challenged with a sublethal dose (10^6.5 TCID50/fish) of MRV-ZQ17 virus.
intervention: Rearing at different temperatures with viral challenge
intervention_record: 不同温度饲养结合病毒攻击

quote: As a result, the infected fish in the 26 °C group died at 6 dpi until there was no additional death occurrence at 12 dpi, with an accumulated mortality of 46.67% (7/15)
statement: 26°C组感染的鱼从第6天开始死亡，直到第12天没有额外死亡发生，累计死亡率为46.67%（7/15）。
text_zh: 26°C组感染的鱼从第6天开始死亡，直到第12天没有额外死亡发生，累计死亡率为46.67%（7/15）。
text_en: Fish infected in the 26°C group began dying from day 6, with no additional deaths occurring until day 12, resulting in a cumulative mortality rate of 46.67% (7/15).

quote: By contrast, no mortality was observed in the 19 °C group
statement: 相比之下，19°C组未观察到死亡。
text_zh: 相比之下，19°C组未观察到死亡。
text_en: In contrast, no mortality was observed in the 19°C group.

quote: The average viral loads in the WBCs from the 20 mandarin fish reared at 19 °C was 18.5 ± 9.7 genome equivalents (GEs) per mg DNA
statement: 在19°C饲养的20条鳜鱼的白细胞中，平均病毒载量为每毫克DNA 18.5 ± 9.7个基因组当量。
text_zh: 在19°C饲养的20条鳜鱼的白细胞中，平均病毒载量为每毫克DNA 18.5 ± 9.7个基因组当量。
text_en: In the leukocytes of 20 mandarin fish reared at 19°C, the average viral load was 18.5 ± 9.7 genome equivalents per mg of DNA.

quote: At 30 dpi, the average viral loads in the WBCs of the 20 mandarin fish reared at 19 °C was 18.5 ± 9.7 GEs per mg DNA, whereas it was 33.9 ± 20.7 GEs per mg DNA from the 8 survival mandarin fish reared at 26 °C.
statement: 在感染后30天，19°C饲养的鳜鱼白细胞中的平均病毒载量为18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA，而26°C饲养的存活鳜鱼为33.9 ± 20.7 GEs/mg DNA。
text_zh: 在感染后30天，19°C饲养的鳜鱼白细胞中的平均病毒载量为18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA，而26°C饲养的存活鳜鱼为33.9 ± 20.7 GEs/mg DNA。
text_en: At 30 days post-infection, the average viral load in leukocytes of mandarin fish reared at 19°C was 18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA, while that of surviving mandarin fish reared at 26°C was 33.9 ± 20.7 GEs/mg DNA.

quote: The MRV-ZQ17 isolate was used for the vaccine preparation, as previously described [ 41 ].
statement: MRV-ZQ17分离株被用于疫苗制备。
text_zh: MRV-ZQ17分离株被用于疫苗制备。
text_en: The MRV-ZQ17 isolate was used for vaccine preparation.

quote: Additionally, using an anti-MRV mAb-based colloidal gold-immunochromatographic fast-detection strip, blood samples from the survival fish showed negative results, whereas the result was strongly positive for the ascites sample from the moribund mandarin fish in group I ( Figure 1 E).
statement: 使用基于抗MRV单克隆抗体的胶体金免疫层析快速检测试纸条，存活鱼的血液样本呈阴性，而濒死鳜鱼腹水样本呈强阳性。
text_zh: 使用基于抗MRV单克隆抗体的胶体金免疫层析快速检测试纸条，存活鱼的血液样本呈阴性，而濒死鳜鱼腹水样本呈强阳性。
text_en: Using colloidal gold immunochromatographic rapid test strips based on anti-MRV monoclonal antibodies, blood samples from surviving fish were negative, while ascites samples from moribund mandarin fish showed strong positive results.

quote: Subsequently, the temperature stress was raised in 19 °C infection group. As a result, a total of five mandarin fish (designated as M2, M8, M11, M13 and M15) died successively on the 10th, 12th, 14th and 15th days (from 24 °C to 26 °C).
statement: 在19°C感染组中提高温度应激（从24°C升至26°C）后，共有五条鳜鱼在第10、12、14和15天相继死亡。
text_zh: 在19°C感染组中提高温度应激（从24°C升至26°C）后，共有五条鳜鱼在第10、12、14和15天相继死亡。
text_en: In the group infected at 19°C, after increasing temperature stress (from 24°C to 26°C), a total of five mandarin fish died successively on days 10, 12, 14 and 15.

quote: Among them, obvious ascites was observed only in M13.
statement: 在这些死亡的鱼中，仅M13观察到明显的腹水。
text_zh: 在这些死亡的鱼中，仅M13观察到明显的腹水。
text_en: Among these dead fish, obvious ascites was observed only in M13.

quote: Moreover, high levels of MRV load were measured in various organs of M2, M8 and M13 ( Figure 2 B), indicating that these fish died of MRV infection.
statement: 此外，在M2、M8和M13的各种器官中检测到高水平的MRV载量，表明这些鱼死于MRV感染。
text_zh: 此外，在M2、M8和M13的各种器官中检测到高水平的MRV载量，表明这些鱼死于MRV感染。
text_en: In addition, high levels of MRV load were detected in various organs of M2, M8, and M13, indicating that these fish died from MRV infection.

quote: IHC also demonstrated a substantial number of virus-positive signals, also indicating an active MRV infection ( Figure 2 C).
statement: 免疫组化也显示了大量病毒阳性信号，同样表明存在活跃的MRV感染。
text_zh: 免疫组化也显示了大量病毒阳性信号，同样表明存在活跃的MRV感染。
text_en: Immunohistochemistry also showed abundant virus-positive signals, similarly indicating an active MRV infection.

quote: The qPCR analysis revealed that the average MRV copy number in the WBCs from the 15 surviving mandarin fish was 139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA ( Figure 2 D,E).
statement: qPCR分析显示，15条存活鳜鱼白细胞中的平均MRV拷贝数为139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA。
text_zh: qPCR分析显示，15条存活鳜鱼白细胞中的平均MRV拷贝数为139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA。
text_en: qPCR analysis showed that the average MRV copy number in leukocytes of 15 surviving mandarin fish was 139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA.

quote: A repeated experiment with 20 covert MRV mandarin fish treated with DXMS resulted in an accumulative mortality of 50% (10/20) ( Figure 3 E).
statement: 对20只隐性MRV鳜鱼进行DXMS处理的重复实验导致累计死亡率为50%（10/20）。
text_zh: 对20只隐性MRV鳜鱼进行DXMS处理的重复实验导致累计死亡率为50%（10/20）。
text_en: A repeat experiment of DXMS treatment on 20隐性 MRV mandarin fish resulted in a cumulative mortality rate of 50% (10/20).

quote: No dead fish were observed in the E. coli injection group ( Figure 3 C).
statement: 在大肠杆菌注射组中未观察到死鱼。
text_zh: 在大肠杆菌注射组中未观察到死鱼。
text_en: No dead fish were observed in the E. coli injection group.

quote: Blood samples were collected from all of the survival fish on the 7th day post- E. coli treatment for conventional PCR or colloidal gold-immunochromatographic fast detection, and both showed MRV negativity, indicating that the E. coli treatment could not activate covert MRV to a detectable level.
statement: 对存活鱼采集血液样本进行检测，结果显示MRV阴性，表明大肠杆菌处理未能将隐性MRV激活至可检测水平。
text_zh: 对存活鱼采集血液样本进行检测，结果显示MRV阴性，表明大肠杆菌处理未能将隐性MRV激活至可检测水平。
text_en: Blood samples collected from surviving fish tested negative for MRV, indicating that E. coli treatment failed to activate latent MRV to detectable levels.

quote: Mandarin fish (weighing ~250 g) were infected with a sublethal dose (10 6.5 TCID 50 /fish) of MRV and maintained for 30 days to ensure the establishment of MRV-PCI.
statement: 体重约250克的桂花鱼以亚致死剂量（10^6.5 TCID50/尾）感染MRV并维持30天以确保建立MRV潜伏感染。
text_zh: 体重约250克的桂花鱼以亚致死剂量（10^6.5 TCID50/尾）感染MRV并维持30天以确保建立MRV潜伏感染。
text_en: Mandarin fish weighing about 250 g were infected with MRV at a sublethal dose (10^6.5 TCID50/fish) and maintained for 30 days to ensure the establishment of latent MRV infection.

quote: the MRV genomic load in the WBCs increased significantly ( n 0.1) regardless of the DXMS treatment at 1 day and 3 days
statement: 无论是否进行DXMS处理，在第1天和第3天，白细胞中的MRV基因组载量均显著增加。
text_zh: 无论是否进行DXMS处理，在第1天和第3天，白细胞中的MRV基因组载量均显著增加。
text_en: Regardless of whether DXMS treatment was performed, the MRV genome load in leukocytes increased significantly on day 1 and day 3.
counterevidence: DXMS处理并未导致与对照组不同的病毒载量增加模式，两者均显著增加

quote: whereas CyHV2/GFHNV establishes persistent infection in goldfish monocytes/M Ø and could be reactivated by DXMS treatment
statement: CyHV2/GFHNV在金鱼单核细胞/巨噬细胞中建立持续感染，并可通过DXMS处理重新激活。
text_zh: CyHV2/GFHNV在金鱼单核细胞/巨噬细胞中建立持续感染，并可通过DXMS处理重新激活。
text_en: CyHV2/GFHNV establishes persistent infection in goldfish monocytes/macrophages and can be reactivated by DXMS treatment.

quote: As a result, mortality was observed in the DXMS-treated group but not in the heat-killed E. coil -treated group.
statement: 在DXMS处理组中观察到死亡率，而在热灭活大肠杆菌处理组中未观察到死亡率。
text_zh: 在DXMS处理组中观察到死亡率，而在热灭活大肠杆菌处理组中未观察到死亡率。
text_en: Mortality was observed in the DXMS treatment group, while no mortality was observed in the heat-inactivated E. coli treatment group.
intervention: DXMS vs heat-inactivated E. coli treatment

quote: DXMS could induce the persistent CyHV-2 to replicate via effectively suppressing monocyte/M Ø function and antibody production [ 44 ].
statement: DXMS可通过有效抑制单核细胞/巨噬细胞功能和抗体产生来诱导持续性CyHV-2复制。
text_zh: DXMS可通过有效抑制单核细胞/巨噬细胞功能和抗体产生来诱导持续性CyHV-2复制。
text_en: DXMS can induce persistent CyHV-2 replication by effectively inhibiting monocyte/macrophage function and antibody production.

population.species: 金鱼 (Carassius auratus) 和普鲁士鲤鱼 (Carassius auratus gibelio)

quote: Water temperature stress, vaccination stimulation and DXMS treatment can reactivate the quiescent MRV to replicate in abundance via a non-TLR5-mediated manner, and results in the recurrence of MRV disease.
statement: 水温应激、疫苗刺激和DXMS处理可以通过非TLR5介导的方式激活潜伏的MRV大量复制，并导致MRV疾病复发。
text_zh: 水温应激、疫苗刺激和DXMS处理可以通过非TLR5介导的方式激活潜伏的MRV大量复制，并导致MRV疾病复发。
text_en: Water temperature stress, vaccine stimulation, and DXMS treatment can activate latent MRV massive replication via a non-TLR5-mediated pathway, leading to MRV disease recurrence.
intervention: Temperature stress, vaccination and DXMS treatment
outcome: 疾病复发与病毒再激活

quote: For cold-blooded animals, many habitat characteristics such as the water chemistry, soil type, ambient temperature, hydroperiod, UV-B as well as population density can affect the onset of viral diseases
statement: 对于冷血动物，许多栖息地特征（如水化学、土壤类型、环境温度、水文周期、UV-B以及种群密度）会影响病毒性疾病的发生。
text_zh: 对于冷血动物，许多栖息地特征（如水化学、土壤类型、环境温度、水文周期、UV-B以及种群密度）会影响病毒性疾病的发生。
text_en: For cold-blooded animals, many habitat characteristics (such as water chemistry, soil type, environmental temperature, hydrological cycle, UV-B, and population density) affect the occurrence of viral diseases.

quote: In the artificial challenge of ISKNV, a water temperature of 20 °C was experimentally evidenced as the threshold temperature
statement: 在ISKNV的人工攻击实验中，20°C的水温被实验证明为阈值温度。
text_zh: 在ISKNV的人工攻击实验中，20°C的水温被实验证明为阈值温度。
text_en: In the artificial challenge experiment with ISKNV, a water temperature of 20°C was proven to be the threshold temperature.

quote: Over 20 °C, the ISKNV was shown to be highly lethal to mandarin fish regardless of the various infection routines, including the administration by i.p. or intramuscular (i.m.) injection and cohabitation infection manner; however, ISKNV never showed lethality to mandarin fish when the experimental temperature was below 20 °C.
statement: 超过20°C时，无论感染途径如何（包括腹腔注射、肌肉注射和共养感染），ISKNV对桂花鱼均表现出高致死性；然而，当实验温度低于20°C时，ISKNV从未显示出对桂花鱼的致死性。
text_zh: 超过20°C时，无论感染途径如何（包括腹腔注射、肌肉注射和共养感染），ISKNV对桂花鱼均表现出高致死性；然而，当实验温度低于20°C时，ISKNV从未显示出对桂花鱼的致死性。
text_en: Above 20°C, ISKNV showed high lethality to mandarin fish regardless of the infection route (including intraperitoneal injection, intramuscular injection, and cohabitation infection); however, when the experimental temperature was below 20°C, ISKNV never showed lethality to mandarin fish.

quote: our data showed that 19 °C was also a nonpermissive temperature for the onset of MRV disease, whereas 26 °C was a permissive temperature for MRV outbreak.
statement: 我们的数据显示，19°C也是MRV疾病发生的非允许温度，而26°C是MRV爆发的允许温度。
text_zh: 我们的数据显示，19°C也是MRV疾病发生的非允许温度，而26°C是MRV爆发的允许温度。
text_en: Our data show that 19°C is also a non-permissive temperature for MRV disease occurrence, while 26°C is a permissive temperature for MRV outbreaks.

quote: Under a sublethal dosage of MRV challenge, no fish died (0/20) in the 19 °C group, but 46.7% (7/15) of the fish died of MRV infection, accompanied with ascites symptoms, within 5 dpi in the 26 °C group.
statement: 在亚致死剂量MRV攻击下，19°C组无鱼死亡，而26°C组有46.7%的鱼在5天内死于MRV感染并伴有腹水症状。
text_zh: 在亚致死剂量MRV攻击下，19°C组无鱼死亡，而26°C组有46.7%的鱼在5天内死于MRV感染并伴有腹水症状。
text_en: Under a sublethal dose MRV challenge, no fish died in the 19°C group, while 46.7% of fish in the 26°C group died from MRV infection within 5 days with ascites symptoms.

quote: This study showed that the w/o formulation of the inactivated MRV vaccine also induced a similar outcome for covert MRV.
statement: 本研究表明，油包水配方的灭活MRV疫苗对隐性MRV也产生了类似的后果（即诱导大量死亡）。
text_zh: 本研究表明，油包水配方的灭活MRV疫苗对隐性MRV也产生了类似的后果（即诱导大量死亡）。
text_en: This study showed that the water-in-oil formulation of inactivated MRV vaccine produced similar consequences (i.e., induced mass mortality) for latent MRV.

quote: The induced peritonitis might trigger the reactivation of covert MRV.
statement: 疫苗引起的腹膜炎可能会触发隐性MRV的再激活。
text_zh: 疫苗引起的腹膜炎可能会触发隐性MRV的再激活。
text_en: Vaccine-induced peritonitis may trigger the reactivation of latent MRV.

quote: the covert MRV can be triggered reactivation through various pathways, encompassing temperature stress, vaccination and the stimulation of the immunosuppressive agent DXMS.
statement: 隐性MRV可以通过多种途径被触发再激活，包括温度应激、疫苗接种和免疫抑制剂DXMS的刺激。
text_zh: 隐性MRV可以通过多种途径被触发再激活，包括温度应激、疫苗接种和免疫抑制剂DXMS的刺激。
text_en: Latent MRV can be triggered to reactivate through multiple pathways, including temperature stress, vaccination, and stimulation by the immunosuppressant DXMS.
intervention: Temperature stress, vaccination and DXMS treatment

quote: Under the DXMS treatment, the covert MRV was reactivated, as expected, with the slight upregulation expression of 15 of the 16 TLR genes.
statement: 在DXMS处理下，如预期那样，隐性MRV被重新激活，且16个TLR基因中有15个表达轻微上调。
text_zh: 在DXMS处理下，如预期那样，隐性MRV被重新激活，且16个TLR基因中有15个表达轻微上调。
text_en: Under DXMS treatment, latent MRV was reactivated as expected, and 15 of the 16 TLR genes showed slightly upregulated expression.
outcome: 病毒再激活与免疫反应

quote: In production practice, the surviving fishes from the ISKNV epidemic would usually never experience a recurrence of ISKNV infection; however, for MRV, after a primary infection, the surviving fishes were transformed into a chronic infection state, which could last for at least 5 months [ 14 ].
statement: 在生产实践中，从ISKNV疫情中存活的鱼类通常不会再次感染ISKNV；然而，对于MRV，初次感染后存活的鱼类会转变为慢性感染状态，这种状态可持续至少5个月。
text_zh: 在生产实践中，从ISKNV疫情中存活的鱼类通常不会再次感染ISKNV；然而，对于MRV，初次感染后存活的鱼类会转变为慢性感染状态，这种状态可持续至少5个月。
text_en: In production practice, fish that survive an ISKNV outbreak usually do not become reinfected with ISKNV; however, for MRV, fish that survive the initial infection enter a chronic infection state, which can last for at least 5 months.
counterevidence: MRV感染导致长期慢性携带状态，不同于ISKNV的清除模式。

quote: As a result, three fish succumbed on the 6th, 7th and 12th days post-vaccination ( Figure 3 A).
statement: 在接种疫苗后的第6、7和12天，有三条鱼死亡。
text_zh: 在接种疫苗后的第6、7和12天，有三条鱼死亡。
text_en: Three fish died on days 6, 7, and 12 after vaccination.
intervention_record: 无佐剂灭活MRV疫苗腹腔注射

quote: QPCR analysis confirmed significant viral load changes in all three dead fish ( Figure 3 B), suggesting that the inactivated MRV vaccine reactivated the covert MRV and partially resulted in the fatal outcome.
statement: QPCR分析证实所有三条死鱼体内病毒载量发生显著变化，表明灭活MRV疫苗重新激活了隐性MRV并部分导致了致命结果。
text_zh: QPCR分析证实所有三条死鱼体内病毒载量发生显著变化，表明灭活MRV疫苗重新激活了隐性MRV并部分导致了致命结果。
text_en: QPCR analysis confirmed significant changes in viral load in all three dead fish, indicating that the inactivated MRV vaccine reactivated latent MRV and partially contributed to the fatal outcome.
intervention_record: 无佐剂灭活MRV疫苗腹腔注射

quote: A repeated experiment involving 20 covert-infected individuals injected with the MRV vaccine resulted in an accumulative mortality of 35% (7/20) ( Figure 3 E).
statement: 涉及20只隐性感染个体注射MRV疫苗的重复实验导致累计死亡率为35%（7/20）。
text_zh: 涉及20只隐性感染个体注射MRV疫苗的重复实验导致累计死亡率为35%（7/20）。
text_en: A repeat experiment involving 20 individuals with latent infection injected with the MRV vaccine resulted in a cumulative mortality rate of 35% (7/20).
intervention_record: 无佐剂灭活MRV疫苗腹腔注射

quote: The QPCR of the tissues from the diseased fish showed high levels of MRV load ( Figure 3 F).
statement: 患病鱼组织的QPCR显示高水平的MRV载量。
text_zh: 患病鱼组织的QPCR显示高水平的MRV载量。
text_en: QPCR of diseased fish tissues showed high levels of MRV load.
intervention_record: 无佐剂灭活MRV疫苗腹腔注射

quote: Immunohistochemistry also exhibited a substantial number of virus-positive signals in the pyloric caeca ( Figure 3 H).
statement: 免疫组织化学也在幽门盲肠中显示出大量病毒阳性信号。
text_zh: 免疫组织化学也在幽门盲肠中显示出大量病毒阳性信号。
text_en: Immunohistochemistry also showed abundant virus-positive signals in the pyloric caeca.
intervention_record: 无佐剂灭活MRV疫苗腹腔注射

quote: QPCR analysis confirmed the high viral loads in these dead fish ( Figure 3 D).
statement: QPCR分析证实这些死鱼体内具有高病毒载量。
text_zh: QPCR分析证实这些死鱼体内具有高病毒载量。
text_en: QPCR analysis confirmed that these dead fish had high viral loads.

quote: The qPCR quantification of the tissues from the deceased fish showed high levels of MRV genome DNA ( Figure 3 G), and IHC also displayed a significant number of virus-positive signals in the pyloric caeca ( Figure 3 I).
statement: 对死亡鱼组织的qPCR定量显示高水平的MRV基因组DNA，且IHC也在幽门盲肠中显示出大量病毒阳性信号。
text_zh: 对死亡鱼组织的qPCR定量显示高水平的MRV基因组DNA，且IHC也在幽门盲肠中显示出大量病毒阳性信号。
text_en: qPCR quantification of dead fish tissues showed high levels of MRV genomic DNA, and IHC also revealed abundant virus-positive signals in the pyloric caeca.
outcome: 病毒载量与组织病理学改变

quote: Even if a mild warming stimulation was applied, a partial mortality outcome occurred, and the survival retransformed into a persistent status.
statement: 即使施加温和的升温刺激，仍发生部分死亡结果，且存活者转变为持续感染状态。
text_zh: 即使施加温和的升温刺激，仍发生部分死亡结果，且存活者转变为持续感染状态。
text_en: Even with mild warming stimulation, partial mortality occurred, and survivors transitioned into a persistent infection state.

quote: Finally, the covert MRV could once again be reactivated by the DXMS treatment.
statement: 最后，潜伏的MRV可通过DXMS处理再次被激活。
text_zh: 最后，潜伏的MRV可通过DXMS处理再次被激活。
text_en: Finally, latent MRV can be reactivated by DXMS treatment.

quote: it is a long-term chronic infection with a disease duration of up to 5 months, almost covering the entire breeding cycle of commercial mandarin fish
statement: 这是一种长期慢性感染，病程长达5个月，几乎涵盖了商业养殖鳜鱼的整个养殖周期。
text_zh: 这是一种长期慢性感染，病程长达5个月，几乎涵盖了商业养殖鳜鱼的整个养殖周期。
text_en: This is a long-term chronic infection with a disease course lasting up to 5 months, covering almost the entire farming cycle of commercial mandarin fish.

quote:
经FKG4 免疫后，翘嘴鳜3 个调节亚基在血液、
鳃、头肾、肠、脾及胸腺组织中的表达也有差异(图
6)。
statement: 使用FKG4进行免疫刺激后，翘嘴鳜NADPH氧化酶三个调节亚基在不同组织中的基因表达出现差异。
text_zh: 使用FKG4进行免疫刺激后，翘嘴鳜NADPH氧化酶三个调节亚基在不同组织中的基因表达出现差异。
text_en: After immunostimulation with FKG4, gene expression of the three regulatory subunits of NADPH oxidase in Siniperca chuatsi showed differences across different tissues.

quote: The MRV could be easily detected through the colloidal gold-immunochromatographic fast-detection strip, conventional PCR as well as MFF-1-based virus isolation.
statement: 胶体金免疫层析快速检测试纸条、常规PCR以及基于MFF-1的病毒分离均可轻松检测出MRV。
text_zh: 胶体金免疫层析快速检测试纸条、常规PCR以及基于MFF-1的病毒分离均可轻松检测出MRV。
text_en: Colloidal gold immunochromatographic rapid test strips, conventional PCR, and virus isolation based on MFF-1 can all easily detect MRV.

quote: Since no additional mortality occurred and the viral load in the blood was too low to be detected by conventional PCR and the colloidal gold-immunochromatographic fast-detection strip, it is proposed that all of these fish entered the covert infection phase.
statement: 由于没有发生额外死亡且血液中的病毒载量低到无法被常规PCR和胶体金试纸条检测到，因此推测这些鱼进入了隐性感染阶段。
text_zh: 由于没有发生额外死亡且血液中的病毒载量低到无法被常规PCR和胶体金试纸条检测到，因此推测这些鱼进入了隐性感染阶段。
text_en: Since no additional deaths occurred and the viral load in the blood was too low to be detected by conventional PCR and colloidal gold test strips, it is inferred that these fish entered a latent infection stage.

quote: By contrast, under the permissive temperature of 26 °C, the infection with a sublethal dosage of MRV could result in partial mortality, and the survival fish could then be transited into the persistent state.
statement: 相比之下，在26°C的允许温度下，亚致死剂量的MRV感染可能导致部分死亡，幸存的鱼随后可以转变为持续感染状态。
text_zh: 相比之下，在26°C的允许温度下，亚致死剂量的MRV感染可能导致部分死亡，幸存的鱼随后可以转变为持续感染状态。
text_en: In contrast, at an allowable temperature of 26°C, sublethal MRV infection may lead to partial mortality, and surviving fish can subsequently transition into a persistent infection state.

quote: During the gradual raising of the temperature, five fish died and three of them were measured with high viral loads.
statement: 在逐渐升温过程中，五条鱼死亡，其中三条测得高病毒载量。
text_zh: 在逐渐升温过程中，五条鱼死亡，其中三条测得高病毒载量。
text_en: During gradual temperature increase, five fish died, of which three had high viral loads.

quote: The absolute qPCR showed that the average viral load (N = 15) in the WBCs from the survival fish was 139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA, which is much higher than that (18.5 ± 9.7 GEs per mg DNA) from the fish (N = 20) before the temperature stress.
statement: 绝对qPCR显示，存活鱼白细胞中的平均病毒载量为139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA，远高于温度应激前鱼的病毒载量（18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA）。
text_zh: 绝对qPCR显示，存活鱼白细胞中的平均病毒载量为139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA，远高于温度应激前鱼的病毒载量（18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA）。
text_en: Absolute qPCR showed that the average viral load in leukocytes of surviving fish was 139 ± 165 GEs/mg DNA, much higher than the viral load of fish before temperature stress (18.5 ± 9.7 GEs/mg DNA).

quote: 经柱状黄杆菌灭活苗FKG4免疫后，p40phox亚基mRNA在翘嘴鳜血液和头肾中的表达量显著上升，p47phox在头肾和脾脏中的表达量显著上升，而p67phox在血液、头肾和脾脏中的表达量均显著上升。
statement: 使用柱状黄杆菌灭活苗FKG4对翘嘴鳜进行免疫后，其NADPH氧化酶三个调节亚基（p40phox、p47phox、p67phox）在特定组织中的mRNA表达量显著上升。
text_zh: 使用柱状黄杆菌灭活苗FKG4对翘嘴鳜进行免疫后，其NADPH氧化酶三个调节亚基（p40phox、p47phox、p67phox）在特定组织中的mRNA表达量显著上升。
text_en: After immunizing Mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) with the inactivated Flavobacterium columnare vaccine FKG4, the mRNA expression levels of the three regulatory subunits of NADPH oxidase (p40phox, p47phox, and p67phox) increased significantly in specific tissues.

quote:
实验前，将购得的鱼（450±50）g 在实
验室自动充气水循环系统中人工饲养14 d，水温保
持(25±1) °C，每日投喂小杂鱼作为饲料，选取健康
的鱼作实验用。
statement: 实验鱼在实验室自动充气水循环系统中饲养14天，水温控制在25±1°C，每日投喂小杂鱼。
text_zh: 实验鱼在实验室自动充气水循环系统中饲养14天，水温控制在25±1°C，每日投喂小杂鱼。
text_en: The experimental fish were kept for 14 days in a laboratory automatic aerated water circulation system, with the water temperature controlled at 25±1°C, and fed small miscellaneous fish daily.

population.system: 实验室自动充气水循环系统

quote: 取25 ℃振荡培养36 h的柱状黄杆菌培养液100 mL，10 000 g离心10 min，沉淀用无菌PBS(pH7.2) 清洗3 次，用含1.0%福尔马林的PBS重悬，室温下灭活24 h，10 000 g离心10 min，PBS清洗两次，离心，用无菌PBS稀释到约1.0×108 cell s/mL，置于4 °C冰箱备用。
statement: 通过振荡培养、离心清洗及福尔马林灭活处理制备柱状黄杆菌菌苗。
text_zh: 通过振荡培养、离心清洗及福尔马林灭活处理制备柱状黄杆菌菌苗。
text_en: Flavobacterium columnare vaccine was prepared by shake culture, centrifugal washing, and formalin inactivation.

quote: 免疫注射前，将FKG4菌苗取出升温至室温，实验鱼用MS222 溶液(1 mg/L)麻醉，分为2 个组，每组6 条，一组每尾鱼经胸鳍下注射0.1 mL的FKG4，另一组则每尾注射同等剂量的灭菌PBS作为对照组，然后继续饲养7 d取样。
statement: 实验鱼经MS222麻醉后，分别接受FKG4菌苗或PBS对照液的胸鳍下注射，随后饲养7天。
text_zh: 实验鱼经MS222麻醉后，分别接受FKG4菌苗或PBS对照液的胸鳍下注射，随后饲养7天。
text_en: After being anesthetized with MS222, the experimental fish received subpectoral fin injections of either FKG4 vaccine or PBS control solution, and were then reared for 7 days.
intervention_record: 疫苗接种或采样前麻醉
outcome: 应激控制与免疫接种操作

quote: In the present study, to investigate the effect of memory on feeding habit transformation, we compared the reaction time to dead prey fish and the success rate of feeding habit transformation from live prey fish to dead prey fish of mandarin fish in the 1st experimental group (trained once) and the 2nd experimental group (trained twice).
statement: 本研究通过比较训练一次和训练两次的鳜鱼对死饵的反应时间及摄食习性转变成功率，来探究记忆对摄食习性转变的影响。
text_zh: 本研究通过比较训练一次和训练两次的鳜鱼对死饵的反应时间及摄食习性转变成功率，来探究记忆对摄食习性转变的影响。
text_en: This study investigated the effect of memory on the transition of feeding habits by comparing the response time to dead bait and the success rate of feeding habit transition in mandarin fish trained once versus twice.

quote: The behavioral parameters, expression of genes involved in learning and memory, and DNA methylation levels in the CpGs of the T1R1 gene involved in feed identification were examined in mandarin fish.
statement: 研究检测了鳜鱼的行为参数、学习与记忆相关基因的表达以及参与饲料识别的T1R1基因CpG位点的DNA甲基化水平。
text_zh: 研究检测了鳜鱼的行为参数、学习与记忆相关基因的表达以及参与饲料识别的T1R1基因CpG位点的DNA甲基化水平。
text_en: The study examined behavioral parameters of mandarin fish, the expression of genes related to learning and memory, and the DNA methylation levels at CpG sites of the T1R1 gene involved in feed recognition.
outcome: 分子机制与表观遗传调控

quote: After pre-training for 6 days, all mandarin fish have great potentialities to accept dead prey fish.
statement: 经过6天的预训练后，所有鳜鱼都表现出接受死饵的巨大潜力。
text_zh: 经过6天的预训练后，所有鳜鱼都表现出接受死饵的巨大潜力。
text_en: After 6 days of pre-training, all mandarin fish showed great potential to accept dead bait.

quote: The success rate of feeding habit transformation to dead prey fish was 0.67 ± 0.01 (67%) in the 1st experimental group, and the success rate reached 1.00 ± 0.00 (100%) in the 2nd experimental group.
statement: 第1实验组（训练一次）转变为吃死饵的成功率为67%，而第2实验组（训练两次）的成功率达到100%。
text_zh: 第1实验组（训练一次）转变为吃死饵的成功率为67%，而第2实验组（训练两次）的成功率达到100%。

quote: They can be trained to transform their innate feeding habit to accept dead prey fish
statement: 可以通过训练使鳜鱼改变其先天摄食习性以接受死饵鱼。
text_zh: 可以通过训练使鳜鱼改变其先天摄食习性以接受死饵鱼。
text_en: Training can be used to change the innate feeding habits of mandarin fish to accept dead bait fish.

quote: Mandarin fish refuse dead prey fish or artificial diets and can be trained to transform their inborn feeding habit.
statement: 鳜鱼拒绝死饵鱼或人工饲料，但可以通过训练改变其天生的摄食习惯。
text_zh: 鳜鱼拒绝死饵鱼或人工饲料，但可以通过训练改变其天生的摄食习惯。
text_en: Mandarin fish refuse dead baitfish or artificial feed, but their innate feeding habits can be changed through training.

quote: The mandarin fish in the 2nd group had higher success rate of feeding habit transformation (100%) than those in the 1st group (67%), and shorter reaction time to dead prey fish ( 1 s) than those in the 1st group ( 1 s).
statement: 经过两次训练的鳜鱼组比一次训练组的摄食习惯转化成功率更高（100% vs 67%），且对死饵鱼的反应时间更短。
text_zh: 经过两次训练的鳜鱼组比一次训练组的摄食习惯转化成功率更高（100% vs 67%），且对死饵鱼的反应时间更短。
text_en: The group of mandarin fish trained twice had a higher success rate in converting feeding habits than the group trained once (100% vs 67%), and had a shorter reaction time to dead bait fish.

quote: Gene expression of cAMP responsive element binding protein I ( Creb I ), brain-derived neurotrophic factor ( Bdnf ), CCAAT enhancer binding protein delta ( C/EBPD ), fos-related antigen 2 ( Fra2 ), and proto-oncogenes c-fos ( c-fos ) involved in long-term memory formation were significantly increased in the 2nd group after repeated training, and taste 1 receptor member 1 ( T1R1 ), involved in feeding habit formation, was significantly increased in brains of the 2nd group after repeated training.
statement: 重复训练后，第二组中涉及长期记忆形成的基因（Creb I, Bdnf, C/EBPD, Fra2, c-fos）以及涉及摄食习惯形成的味觉受体基因T1R1的表达显著增加。
text_zh: 重复训练后，第二组中涉及长期记忆形成的基因（Creb I, Bdnf, C/EBPD, Fra2, c-fos）以及涉及摄食习惯形成的味觉受体基因T1R1的表达显著增加。
text_en: After repeated training, the expression of genes involved in long-term memory formation (Creb I, Bdnf, C/EBPD, Fra2, c-fos) and the taste receptor gene T1R1 involved in feeding habit formation significantly increased in the second group.

quote: These results indicated that the repeated training can improve the feeding habit transformation through the memory formation of accepting dead prey fish.
statement: 结果表明，通过形成接受死饵鱼的记忆，重复训练可以改善摄食习惯的转化。
text_zh: 结果表明，通过形成接受死饵鱼的记忆，重复训练可以改善摄食习惯的转化。
text_en: The results showed that repeated training can improve the conversion of feeding habits by forming a memory of accepting dead bait fish.

quote: To investigate the effect of memory on feeding habit transformation, we compared the success rate of feeding habit transformation to dead prey fish with training of mandarin fish in the 1st experimental group (trained once) and the 2nd experimental group (trained twice).
statement: 研究通过比较一次训练组和两次训练组鳜鱼对死饵摄食习惯转化的成功率，来调查记忆对摄食习惯转化的影响。
text_zh: 研究通过比较一次训练组和两次训练组鳜鱼对死饵摄食习惯转化的成功率，来调查记忆对摄食习惯转化的影响。
text_en: The study investigated the effect of memory on feeding habit conversion by comparing the success rate of converting to dead bait feeding habits in one-training group and two-training group mandarin fish.

quote: The mandarin fish in the 2nd experimental group had higher success rates of feeding habit transformation from live prey fish to dead prey fish (100%) than those in the 1st experimental group (67%), and shorter reaction time to dead prey fish ( 1 s) than those in the 1st experimental group ( 1 s).
statement: 与训练一次的实验组相比，训练两次的鳜鱼从活饵向死饵转变的摄食习惯成功率更高（100%对67%），且对死饵的反应时间更短。
text_zh: 与训练一次的实验组相比，训练两次的鳜鱼从活饵向死饵转变的摄食习惯成功率更高（100%对67%），且对死饵的反应时间更短。
text_en: Compared to the experimental group trained once, mandarin fish trained twice had a higher success rate in shifting feeding habits from live bait to dead bait (100% vs. 67%) and a shorter reaction time to dead bait.

quote: These results indicate that mandarin fish through the first training are much easier and faster to accept dead prey fish during the second training phase.
statement: 结果表明，经过第一次训练的鳜鱼在第二次训练阶段更容易、更快地接受死饵。
text_zh: 结果表明，经过第一次训练的鳜鱼在第二次训练阶段更容易、更快地接受死饵。
text_en: The results showed that mandarin fish trained in the first session accepted dead bait more easily and quickly during the second training phase.

quote: Mandarin fish were able to accept dead prey fish after training, and repeated training promoted the reconsolidation from a labile memory of accepting dead prey fish to a stable memory.
statement: 鳜鱼在经过训练后能够接受死饵，且重复训练促进了从接受死饵的不稳定记忆到稳定记忆的重巩固过程。
text_zh: 鳜鱼在经过训练后能够接受死饵，且重复训练促进了从接受死饵的不稳定记忆到稳定记忆的重巩固过程。
text_en: After training, mandarin fish are able to accept dead bait, and repeated training promotes the reconsolidation process from unstable memory of accepting dead bait to stable memory.

quote: Liang, et al. [ 3 ] indicated that mandarin fish yearlings could accept dead prey fish or artificial diets during feeding, using a training program based on its feeding specific sensory modality.
statement: Liang等人指出，基于鳜鱼摄食特定感觉模态的训练方案，可以使鳜鱼幼鱼在喂食期间接受死饵或人工饲料。
text_zh: Liang等人指出，基于鳜鱼摄食特定感觉模态的训练方案，可以使鳜鱼幼鱼在喂食期间接受死饵或人工饲料。
text_en: Liang et al. pointed out that a training protocol based on specific sensory modalities of feeding in mandarin fish can enable juvenile mandarin fish to accept dead bait or artificial feed during feeding.

quote: It is suggested that memory might play an important role in the feeding habit transformation from live prey fish to dead prey fish for mandarin fish.
statement: 研究表明，记忆可能在鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯转变中发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 研究表明，记忆可能在鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼的摄食习惯转变中发挥重要作用。
text_en: Research indicates that memory may play an important role in the transition of feeding habits from live baitfish to dead baitfish in mandarin fish.

quote: Therefore, environmental changes might transform the feeding habit of fish.
statement: 因此，环境变化可能会改变鱼类的摄食习性。
text_zh: 因此，环境变化可能会改变鱼类的摄食习性。
text_en: Therefore, environmental changes may alter the feeding habits of fish.

quote: The mandarin fish in the 2nd experimental group had a higher ( P 0.05) success rate than those in the 1st experimental group ( Figure 1 ).
statement: 第二次实验组的鳜鱼成功率显著高于第一次实验组。
text_zh: 第二次实验组的鳜鱼成功率显著高于第一次实验组。
text_en: The success rate of mandarin fish in the second experimental group was significantly higher than that in the first experimental group.

quote: Reaction time to dead prey fish of mandarin fish in the 1st and the 2nd experimental groups were 3.21 ± 0.21 s and 0.42 ± 0.02 s, respectively.
statement: 第一次和第二次实验组鳜鱼对死饵的反应时间分别为3.21秒和0.42秒。
text_zh: 第一次和第二次实验组鳜鱼对死饵的反应时间分别为3.21秒和0.42秒。
text_en: The reaction times to dead bait for the first and second experimental groups of mandarin fish were 3.21 seconds and 0.42 seconds, respectively.

quote: The mandarin fish in the 2nd experimental group had shorter ( P 0.05) reaction times to dead prey fish ( 1 s) than did those in the 1st experimental group ( 1 s) ( Figure 2 ).
statement: 第二次实验组的鳜鱼对死饵的反应时间显著短于第一次实验组。
text_zh: 第二次实验组的鳜鱼对死饵的反应时间显著短于第一次实验组。
text_en: The reaction time to dead bait of mandarin fish in the second experimental group was significantly shorter than that in the first experimental group.

quote: Once trained, mandarin fish preyed on dead prey fish faster.
statement: 经过训练后，鳜鱼捕食死饵的速度加快。
text_zh: 经过训练后，鳜鱼捕食死饵的速度加快。
text_en: After training, the speed at which mandarin fish prey on dead bait increased.

quote: In conclusion, mandarin fish through the first training are easier and faster to accept dead prey fish during the second training phase, suggesting that repeated training promotes the reconsolidation from a labile memory of accepting dead prey fish to a stable memory.
statement: 结论指出，经过第一次训练的鳜鱼在第二次训练阶段更容易且更快地接受死饵鱼，表明重复训练促进了从接受死饵鱼的不稳定记忆向稳定记忆的再巩固。
text_zh: 结论指出，经过第一次训练的鳜鱼在第二次训练阶段更容易且更快地接受死饵鱼，表明重复训练促进了从接受死饵鱼的不稳定记忆向稳定记忆的再巩固。
text_en: The conclusion states that mandarin fish trained in the first session accepted dead bait fish more easily and quickly during the second training phase, indicating that repeated training promoted reconsolidation from unstable memory of accepting dead bait fish to stable memory.

quote: The expressions of several genes involved in long-term memory formation and feeding habit formation were significantly different in brains of mandarin fish between the first and second trainings.
statement: 在第一次和第二次训练之间，鳜鱼大脑中参与长期记忆形成和摄食习惯形成的几个基因的表达存在显著差异。
text_zh: 在第一次和第二次训练之间，鳜鱼大脑中参与长期记忆形成和摄食习惯形成的几个基因的表达存在显著差异。
text_en: Between the first and second training sessions, there were significant differences in the expression of several genes involved in long-term memory formation and feeding habit formation in the brain of mandarin fish.

quote: In addition, DNA methylation of the T1R1 gene might be considered as a regulatory factor for feeding habit transformation from live prey fish to dead prey fish in mandarin fish.
statement: 此外，T1R1基因的DNA甲基化可能被视为鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼摄食习惯转变的调节因子。
text_zh: 此外，T1R1基因的DNA甲基化可能被视为鳜鱼从活饵鱼到死饵鱼摄食习惯转变的调节因子。
text_en: In addition, DNA methylation of the T1R1 gene may be regarded as a regulator of the shift in feeding habits from live bait fish to dead bait fish in mandarin fish.

quote: The level of c-fos gene expression was also significantly increased in the first training phase compared with that of the control group that was not exposed to dead fish.
statement: 与未接触死鱼的对照组相比，第一阶段训练组中c-fos基因的表达水平也显著增加。
text_zh: 与未接触死鱼的对照组相比，第一阶段训练组中c-fos基因的表达水平也显著增加。
text_en: Compared to the control group that was not exposed to dead fish, the expression level of the c-fos gene in the first-stage training group also increased significantly.

quote: No mandarin fish died of natural causes during the training phases.
statement: 在训练阶段期间，没有鳜鱼因自然原因死亡。
text_zh: 在训练阶段期间，没有鳜鱼因自然原因死亡。
text_en: During the training phase, no mandarin fish died of natural causes.

quote: At the end of each training phase, the mandarin fish were deeply anesthetized with MS-222 (Argent Chemical Laboratories, Redmond, WA, USA) (200 mg L −1 ) about 2 h after feeding and were killed.
statement: 在每个训练阶段结束时，鳜鱼在喂食后约2小时被MS-222深度麻醉并杀死。
text_zh: 在每个训练阶段结束时，鳜鱼在喂食后约2小时被MS-222深度麻醉并杀死。
text_en: At the end of each training phase, mandarin fish were deeply anesthetized with MS-222 and killed about 2 hours after feeding.

quote: The live and frozen India mrigal fry were used as live prey fish and dead prey fish, respectively, in this study, and frozen fry were thoroughly unfrozen before feeding.
statement: 本研究使用活的印度鲮鱼苗作为活饵，冷冻的印度鲮鱼苗作为死饵，并在喂食前将冷冻鱼苗彻底解冻。
text_zh: 本研究使用活的印度鲮鱼苗作为活饵，冷冻的印度鲮鱼苗作为死饵，并在喂食前将冷冻鱼苗彻底解冻。
text_en: This study used live Indian carp fry as live bait, frozen Indian carp fry as dead bait, and thoroughly thawed the frozen fry before feeding.

quote: All efforts were made to minimize suffering.
statement: 所有努力都旨在最大限度地减少痛苦。
text_zh: 所有努力都旨在最大限度地减少痛苦。
text_en: All efforts are aimed at minimizing suffering.

quote: Each mandarin fish was kept in an independent aquarium and fed a maximum number of 3 live or dead prey fish once daily at 5:30 pm.
statement: 每条鳜鱼被单独饲养在独立的水族箱中，每天下午5:30最多喂食3条活饵或死饵。
text_zh: 每条鳜鱼被单独饲养在独立的水族箱中，每天下午5:30最多喂食3条活饵或死饵。
text_en: Each mandarin fish was housed individually in a separate aquarium, and fed up to 3 live or dead baits daily at 5:30 PM.
intervention: Individual tank scheduled and quantified feeding
intervention_record: 单缸饲养定时定量投喂

quote: Prior to the experiment, each mandarin fish was kept in an independent aquarium (60 × 45 × 45 cm) where it was accommodated to a continuous water filtration system and dissolved oxygen (7.26–7.86 mg/L), temperature (25 ± 1 °C), and pH (7.11–7.59) at constant values.
statement: 实验前，每条鳜鱼被单独饲养在独立水族箱中，并适应连续水过滤系统以及恒定的溶解氧、温度和pH值。
text_zh: 实验前，每条鳜鱼被单独饲养在独立水族箱中，并适应连续水过滤系统以及恒定的溶解氧、温度和pH值。
