text_en: Before the experiment, each mandarin fish was housed individually in a separate aquarium and acclimated to a continuous water filtration system as well as constant dissolved oxygen, temperature, and pH levels.

quote: They were fed once daily at 5:30 pm with live India mrigal ( Cirrhinus mrigala ) juveniles as live prey fish for 2 weeks.
statement: 它们每天下午5:30喂食一次活的印度鲮幼鱼作为活饵鱼，持续2周。
text_zh: 它们每天下午5:30喂食一次活的印度鲮幼鱼作为活饵鱼，持续2周。
text_en: They were fed live Indian carp fry once daily at 5:30 PM as live bait fish for 2 weeks.

quote: Mandarin fish accepted the live prey fish immediately for feed or had no response, and the live prey fish that had not been eated were left in the aquarium.
statement: 鳜鱼立即接受活饵鱼进行摄食或无反应，未被吃掉的活饵鱼留在水族箱中。
text_zh: 鳜鱼立即接受活饵鱼进行摄食或无反应，未被吃掉的活饵鱼留在水族箱中。
text_en: Mandarin fish immediately accepted live bait fish for feeding or showed no response; uneaten live bait fish remained in the aquarium.

quote: Each mandarin fish consumed statistically 2–3 live prey fish every day in the adaptation phase.
statement: 在适应阶段，每条鳜鱼平均每天统计消耗2-3条活饵鱼。
text_zh: 在适应阶段，每条鳜鱼平均每天统计消耗2-3条活饵鱼。
text_en: During the acclimation phase, each mandarin fish consumed an average of 2-3 live baitfish per day.

quote: ence has also indicated that NNV can infect mature groupers ( Epinephelus spp.), resulting in high mortality [ 8 ].
statement: 已有证据表明NNV可感染成熟石斑鱼（Epinephelus spp.），导致高死亡率。
text_zh: 已有证据表明NNV可感染成熟石斑鱼（Epinephelus spp.），导致高死亡率。
text_en: Existing evidence indicates that NNV can infect mature grouper (Epinephelus spp.), causing high mortality.

quote: Abnormal swimming was observed in RGNNV-infected Mandarin fish.
statement: 在感染RGNNV的鳜鱼中观察到异常游泳行为。
text_zh: 在感染RGNNV的鳜鱼中观察到异常游泳行为。
text_en: Abnormal swimming behavior was observed in mandarin fish infected with RGNNV.

quote: (1) day 1, live prey fish fed to satiation only; (2) days 2–4, gradually replacing live prey fish with dead prey fish within the 10 trials day-by-day; (3) days 5–6, only dead prey fish fed.
statement: 训练步骤包括第一天仅投喂活饵至饱食，第2-4天在10次试验中逐日用死饵替换活饵，第5-6天仅投喂死饵。
text_zh: 训练步骤包括第一天仅投喂活饵至饱食，第2-4天在10次试验中逐日用死饵替换活饵，第5-6天仅投喂死饵。
text_en: The training steps included feeding only live prey to satiation on day 1, gradually replacing live prey with dead prey over 10 trials daily from days 2-4, and feeding only dead prey on days 5-6.

quote: The pre-training phase allowed the mandarin fish to become familiar preying on live or dead prey fish.
statement: 预训练阶段使鳜鱼熟悉捕食活饵或死饵。
text_zh: 预训练阶段使鳜鱼熟悉捕食活饵或死饵。
text_en: The pre-training stage familiarizes mandarin fish with preying on live or dead bait.

quote: Each mandarin fish was kept in an independent aquarium and fed a maximum number of 3 prey fish once daily at 5:30 pm.
statement: 每条鳜鱼单独饲养在一个水族箱中，每天下午5:30最多投喂3条饵料鱼。
text_zh: 每条鳜鱼单独饲养在一个水族箱中，每天下午5:30最多投喂3条饵料鱼。
text_en: Each mandarin fish was housed individually in an aquarium, and up to 3 bait fish were fed daily at 5:30 PM.
intervention: Individual tank scheduled and quantified feeding
intervention_record: 单缸饲养定时定量投喂

quote: A dead prey fish was placed 20 cm away from each mandarin fish, and only a single dead prey fish individual was allowed into each aquarium at any time.
statement: 将一条死饵鱼放置在距离鳜鱼20厘米处，且每次每个水族箱只允许放入一条死饵鱼。
text_zh: 将一条死饵鱼放置在距离鳜鱼20厘米处，且每次每个水族箱只允许放入一条死饵鱼。
text_en: A dead bait fish is placed 20 cm away from the mandarin fish, and only one dead bait fish is allowed per aquarium at a time.

quote: Mandarin fish accepted the dead prey fish immediately for feed or had no response for 2 min.
statement: 鳜鱼要么立即接受死饵作为食物，要么在2分钟内无反应。
text_zh: 鳜鱼要么立即接受死饵作为食物，要么在2分钟内无反应。
text_en: Mandarin fish either immediately accepted dead bait as food or showed no response within 2 minutes.
counterevidence: 部分个体对死饵无反应

quote: green but not red signal was observed in RGNNV-infected CPB cells at 24 h p.i. ( Figure 2 A), suggesting that RGNNV infection caused apoptosis at an early stage.
statement: 在感染后24小时的RGNNV感染CPB细胞中观察到绿色信号而非红色信号，表明RGNNV感染在早期阶段引起了细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 在感染后24小时的RGNNV感染CPB细胞中观察到绿色信号而非红色信号，表明RGNNV感染在早期阶段引起了细胞凋亡。
text_en: Green signals rather than red signals were observed in CPB cells infected with RGNNV at 24 hours post-infection, indicating that RGNNV infection induced apoptosis in the early stage.

quote: The trial was performed again if the mandarin fish did not eat 3 dead prey fish, and the trail described above was repeated up to 10 times.
statement: 如果鳜鱼没有吃掉3条死饵鱼，则重新进行试验，且上述试验最多重复10次。
text_zh: 如果鳜鱼没有吃掉3条死饵鱼，则重新进行试验，且上述试验最多重复10次。
text_en: If the mandarin fish does not eat 3 dead bait fish, the test is repeated, and the above test is repeated at most 10 times.

quote: The reaction time to dead prey fish and the success rate of feeding habit transformation to dead prey fish of mandarin fish were counted from the videos.
statement: 通过视频统计鳜鱼对死饵鱼的反应时间和向死饵鱼转变摄食习惯的成功率。
text_zh: 通过视频统计鳜鱼对死饵鱼的反应时间和向死饵鱼转变摄食习惯的成功率。
text_en: Video statistics were used to measure the response time of mandarin fish to dead bait fish and the success rate of transitioning their feeding habits to dead bait fish.

quote: Regardless of multiple trials, the reaction time for each mandarin fish was recorded as the daily average.
statement: 无论多次试验如何，每尾鳜鱼的反应时间均记录为日平均值。
text_zh: 无论多次试验如何，每尾鳜鱼的反应时间均记录为日平均值。
text_en: Regardless of multiple trials, the response time per mandarin fish was recorded as a daily average.

quote: As long as at least one dead prey fish was successfully accepted among the trails in the day, the mandarin fish was marked as a successful feeding habit transformer to dead prey fish, whereas the mandarin fish was marked as a failure if it ate no dead prey fish.
statement: 只要当天在试验中成功接受至少一条死饵鱼，该鳜鱼即被标记为成功转变为死饵鱼摄食习惯；若未吃任何死饵鱼，则标记为失败。
text_zh: 只要当天在试验中成功接受至少一条死饵鱼，该鳜鱼即被标记为成功转变为死饵鱼摄食习惯；若未吃任何死饵鱼，则标记为失败。
text_en: A mandarin fish was marked as successfully converted to a dead baitfish feeding habit if it successfully accepted at least one dead baitfish in the trial on that day; if it did not eat any dead baitfish, it was marked as failed.

quote: Mandarin fish were fed with live prey fish for the next 6 days.
statement: 在接下来的6天里，给鳜鱼投喂活饵鱼。
text_zh: 在接下来的6天里，给鳜鱼投喂活饵鱼。
text_en: For the next 6 days, mandarin fish were fed live baitfish.

quote: Then, in the revert procedure, live prey fish were the first choice of mandarin fish when the live and dead prey fish were presented at the same time, which proves that they had reverted to the characteristics of feeding live prey fish.
statement: 随后，在恢复程序中，当同时提供活饵鱼和死饵鱼时，活饵鱼成为鳜鱼的首选，这证明它们已恢复到捕食活饵鱼的特征。
text_zh: 随后，在恢复程序中，当同时提供活饵鱼和死饵鱼时，活饵鱼成为鳜鱼的首选，这证明它们已恢复到捕食活饵鱼的特征。
text_en: Subsequently, in the recovery program, when both live bait fish and dead bait fish were provided simultaneously, live bait fish became the preferred choice for mandarin fish, demonstrating that they had recovered their characteristic of preying on live bait fish.

quote: After that, the rest of the mandarin fish ( n = 16) were under the second round of training phase. The procedure of the second training (6 days) was the same as the aforementioned training phase.
statement: 之后，剩余的鳜鱼（n=16）进入第二轮训练阶段。第二次训练（6天）的程序与前述训练阶段相同。
text_zh: 之后，剩余的鳜鱼（n=16）进入第二轮训练阶段。第二次训练（6天）的程序与前述训练阶段相同。
text_en: Afterwards, the remaining mandarin fish (n=16) entered the second training phase. The procedure for the second training (6 days) was the same as the aforementioned training phase.

quote: At four days p.i., abnormal swimming behavior was observed from two of the five RGNNV-infected fish ( Figure 3 A and Supplementary Material ).
statement: 在感染后第4天，5条RGNNV感染鱼中有2条表现出异常游泳行为。
text_zh: 在感染后第4天，5条RGNNV感染鱼中有2条表现出异常游泳行为。
text_en: On day 4 post-infection, 2 out of 5 RGNNV-infected fish exhibited abnormal swimming behavior.

quote: All five RGNNV-infected fish exhibited abnormal swimming behavior at five days p.i.
statement: 在感染后第5天，所有5条RGNNV感染鱼均表现出异常游泳行为。
text_zh: 在感染后第5天，所有5条RGNNV感染鱼均表现出异常游泳行为。
text_en: On day 5 post-infection, all 5 RGNNV-infected fish exhibited abnormal swimming behavior.

quote: However, mock-infected fish swam normally during the observation period.
statement: 然而，模拟感染的鱼在观察期间正常游泳。
text_zh: 然而，模拟感染的鱼在观察期间正常游泳。
text_en: However, fish with simulated infection swam normally during the observation period.

quote: The mitochondria of brain cells from RGNNV-infected fish were swollen ( Figure 5 B) compared to those from mock-infected fish ( Figure 5 A).
statement: 与模拟感染鱼相比，RGNNV感染鱼脑细胞的线粒体出现肿胀。
text_zh: 与模拟感染鱼相比，RGNNV感染鱼脑细胞的线粒体出现肿胀。
text_en: Compared to mock-infected fish, mitochondria in the brain cells of RGNNV-infected fish showed swelling.

quote: RGNNV was detected in brain tissues of all three RGNNV-infected Mandarin fish, but not from the brain tissues of mock-infected Mandarin fish
statement: 在感染RGNNV的鳜鱼脑组织中检测到了病毒，而在模拟感染的对照鱼脑组织中未检测到。
text_zh: 在感染RGNNV的鳜鱼脑组织中检测到了病毒，而在模拟感染的对照鱼脑组织中未检测到。
text_en: The virus was detected in the brain tissue of mandarin fish infected with RGNNV, but not detected in the brain tissue of control fish that were mock-infected.

quote: No apparent pathogenic changes were observed in brain tissues from mock-infected fish ( Figure 4 B), while numerous vacuoles were observed in brain tissues of RGNNV-infected fish ( Figure 4 A)
statement: 模拟感染鱼的脑组织未见明显病理变化，而RGNNV感染鱼的脑组织中观察到大量空泡。
text_zh: 模拟感染鱼的脑组织未见明显病理变化，而RGNNV感染鱼的脑组织中观察到大量空泡。
text_en: No obvious pathological changes were observed in the brain tissue of simulated infected fish, while numerous vacuoles were observed in the brain tissue of RGNNV-infected fish.

quote: NNV usually infects the larvae or juvenile of fish, but evidence has also indicated that NNV can infect mature groupers ( Epinephelus spp.), resulting in high mortality
statement: NNV通常感染鱼的幼体或稚鱼，但证据也表明NNV可以感染成熟石斑鱼，导致高死亡率。
text_zh: NNV通常感染鱼的幼体或稚鱼，但证据也表明NNV可以感染成熟石斑鱼，导致高死亡率。
text_en: NNV usually infects juvenile or fry fish, but evidence also indicates that NNV can infect mature grouper, causing high mortality.

quote: Neurological signs with abnormal swimming behavior were observed in Mandarin fish from four days p.i., indicating that eyeball injection was an efficient way for RGNNV infection.
statement: 在感染后四天观察到鳜鱼出现带有异常游泳行为的神经症状，表明眼球注射是RGNNV感染的一种有效方式。
text_zh: 在感染后四天观察到鳜鱼出现带有异常游泳行为的神经症状，表明眼球注射是RGNNV感染的一种有效方式。
text_en: Neurological symptoms with abnormal swimming behavior were observed in mandarin fish four days after infection, indicating that eye injection is an effective method of RGNNV infection.

quote: Except for the abnormal swimming behavior, vacuolation was observed in RGNNV-infected brains from Mandarin fish, which was consistent with the observation in NNV-infected brains from other fish species
statement: 除了异常游泳行为外，在感染RGNNV的鳜鱼大脑中观察到空泡化，这与其他鱼类NNV感染大脑中的观察结果一致。
text_zh: 除了异常游泳行为外，在感染RGNNV的鳜鱼大脑中观察到空泡化，这与其他鱼类NNV感染大脑中的观察结果一致。
text_en: In addition to abnormal swimming behavior, vacuolation was observed in the brains of mandarin fish infected with RGNNV, which is consistent with observations in the brains of other fish species infected with NNV.

quote: In fact, fish with injured eyeballs are sometimes observed in cultured or wild-ranged ones, implying that the injury of eyeballs might also be a way for the transmission of NNV.
statement: 事实上，在养殖或野生鱼类中有时可以观察到眼球受伤的个体，这意味着眼球受伤也可能是NNV传播的一种方式。
text_zh: 事实上，在养殖或野生鱼类中有时可以观察到眼球受伤的个体，这意味着眼球受伤也可能是NNV传播的一种方式。
text_en: In fact, individuals with eye injuries can sometimes be observed in farmed or wild fish, which means that eye injury may also be a way of NNV transmission.

quote: Electronic microscopy showed that the mitochondria of brain cells from RGNNV-infected Mandarin fish were swollen compared with those from mock-infected fish ( Figure 5 B).
statement: 电子显微镜观察显示，与模拟感染组相比，RGNNV感染的桂花鱼脑细胞的线粒体出现肿胀。
text_zh: 电子显微镜观察显示，与模拟感染组相比，RGNNV感染的桂花鱼脑细胞的线粒体出现肿胀。
text_en: Electron microscopy observations showed that mitochondria in the brain cells of mandarin fish infected with RGNNV were swollen compared to the simulated infection group.
outcome: 细胞器形态与健康（线粒体损伤）

quote: It feeds exclusively on live prey and requires artificial training to accept formulated feeds
statement: 该鱼仅摄食活饵，需要人工训练才能接受配合饲料。
text_zh: 该鱼仅摄食活饵，需要人工训练才能接受配合饲料。
text_en: This fish feeds only on live bait and requires artificial training to accept formulated feed.

quote: which is primarily attributed to the poor palatability and amino acid imbalance in plant-based diets
statement: 上述负面影响主要归因于植物基日粮适口性差和氨基酸不平衡。
text_zh: 上述负面影响主要归因于植物基日粮适口性差和氨基酸不平衡。
text_en: The above negative effects are mainly attributed to the poor palatability and amino acid imbalance of plant-based diets.

quote: However, 20,000 mg/kg of choline supplementation significantly reduced the growth performance and survival rates of the hybrid grouper, suggesting the potential toxicity of choline at elevated concentrations [ 19 ].
statement: 在杂交石斑鱼中，20,000 mg/kg的胆碱补充显著降低了生长性能和存活率，表明高浓度下胆碱具有潜在毒性。
text_zh: 在杂交石斑鱼中，20,000 mg/kg的胆碱补充显著降低了生长性能和存活率，表明高浓度下胆碱具有潜在毒性。

quote: Therefore, determining the optimal level of choline supplementation in feed is essential to enhance fish growth performance while reducing feed costs and avoiding the toxic effects of excessive choline supplementation.
statement: 确定饲料中胆碱的最佳补充水平对于提高鱼类生长性能、降低饲料成本并避免过量胆碱补充的毒性效应至关重要。
text_zh: 确定饲料中胆碱的最佳补充水平对于提高鱼类生长性能、降低饲料成本并避免过量胆碱补充的毒性效应至关重要。
text_en: Determining the optimal choline supplementation level in feed is crucial for improving fish growth performance, reducing feed costs, and avoiding the toxic effects of excessive choline supplementation.

quote: This study systematically studied the effects of dietary choline supplementation on the growth performance, feeding behavior, glucose and lipid metabolism, protein utilization, and energy allocation patterns of Chinese perch, aiming to lay a theoretical foundation for optimizing the supplementation of choline in aquatic feed.
statement: 本研究系统研究了日粮胆碱补充对鳜鱼生长性能、摄食行为、葡萄糖和脂质代谢、蛋白质利用及能量分配模式的影响，旨在为优化水产饲料中的胆碱补充奠定理论基础。
text_zh: 本研究系统研究了日粮胆碱补充对鳜鱼生长性能、摄食行为、葡萄糖和脂质代谢、蛋白质利用及能量分配模式的影响，旨在为优化水产饲料中的胆碱补充奠定理论基础。
text_en: This study systematically investigated the effects of dietary choline supplementation on growth performance, feeding behavior, glucose and lipid metabolism, protein utilization, and energy allocation patterns in mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi), aiming to lay a theoretical foundation for optimizing choline supplementation in aquaculture feeds.
outcome: 生长性能、摄食行为、代谢与能量分配

quote: Our findings demonstrated that choline supplementation significantly elevated the expression level of the orexigenic gene agrp , thereby enhancing the feed intake of fish.
statement: 本研究发现胆碱补充显著提高了食欲基因agrp的表达水平，从而增强了鱼的摄食量。
text_zh: 本研究发现胆碱补充显著提高了食欲基因agrp的表达水平，从而增强了鱼的摄食量。
text_en: This study found that choline supplementation significantly increased the expression level of the appetite gene agrp, thereby enhancing fish feed intake.

quote: Fish were maintained at 28 ± 0.5 °C in a recirculating freshwater system and were fed with forage fish for at least two weeks so that they acclimated to the laboratory conditions before experiments.
statement: 鳜鱼在循环淡水系统中于28±0.5°C饲养，并投喂饵鱼至少两周以适应实验室条件。
text_zh: 鳜鱼在循环淡水系统中于28±0.5°C饲养，并投喂饵鱼至少两周以适应实验室条件。
text_en: Mandarin fish were reared in a recirculating freshwater system at 28±0.5°C and fed baitfish for at least two weeks to acclimate to laboratory conditions.

population.system: recirculating freshwater system (循环淡水系统)

quote: Forage fish and Mandarin fish were free of RGNNV, as tested by RT-PCR.
statement: 通过RT-PCR检测确认饵鱼和鳜鱼均无RGNNV病毒。
text_zh: 通过RT-PCR检测确认饵鱼和鳜鱼均无RGNNV病毒。
text_en: RT-PCR testing confirmed that both bait fish and mandarin fish were free of RGNNV virus.

population.species: Mandarin fish (鳜鱼), Osmerus mordax (胡瓜鱼)

quote: Mandarin fish were anaesthetized by tricaine methanesul-A fonate (MS-222) according to the standard protocol recommended by the manufacturer before challenge.
statement: 在攻毒前，按照制造商推荐的标准方案使用MS-222对鳜鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在攻毒前，按照制造商推荐的标准方案使用MS-222对鳜鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Before challenge, mandarin fish were anesthetized with MS-222 according to the manufacturer's recommended standard protocol.

quote: During acclimation, fish were trained to accept formulated feed (P0) according to established protocols [ 29 , 30 ]
statement: 在驯化期间，根据既定方案对鱼进行了接受配合饲料（P0）的训练。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，根据既定方案对鱼进行了接受配合饲料（P0）的训练。
text_en: During acclimation, fish were trained to accept formulated feed (P0) according to a predetermined protocol.

quote: Fish were anesthetized with 20% MS-222 (Argent Chemical Laboratories, Redmond, WA, USA) for biometric measurements prior to random allocation into 18 circular tanks
statement: 在随机分配到圆形水箱之前，使用20% MS-222对鱼进行麻醉以进行生物测量。
text_zh: 在随机分配到圆形水箱之前，使用20% MS-222对鱼进行麻醉以进行生物测量。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with 20% MS-222 for biometrics before being randomly assigned to circular tanks.

quote: However, outbreaks caused by NNV have been reported recently in freshwater fish [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ].
statement: 然而，最近有报道指出淡水鱼类发生了由NNV引起的疫情爆发。
text_zh: 然而，最近有报道指出淡水鱼类发生了由NNV引起的疫情爆发。
text_en: However, recent reports have indicated outbreaks of NNV in freshwater fish.

quote: In addition, some freshwater fish were reported susceptible to NNV under experimental infection conditions [ 22 , 23 ], indicating a potential spread of NNV in freshwater fish.
statement: 此外，据报道一些淡水鱼在实验感染条件下对NNV易感，表明NNV可能在淡水鱼中传播。
text_zh: 此外，据报道一些淡水鱼在实验感染条件下对NNV易感，表明NNV可能在淡水鱼中传播。
text_en: In addition, it has been reported that some freshwater fish are susceptible to NNV under experimental infection conditions, indicating that NNV may spread in freshwater fish.
outcome: 疾病易感性与传播潜力

quote: NNV usually causes mass mortality to the larvae or juvenile of fish, but for groupers, even the grow-out stage was highly susceptible to NNV infection [ 8 ].
statement: NNV通常导致鱼类幼体或稚鱼大量死亡，但对于石斑鱼，即使是成鱼阶段也对NNV感染高度易感。
text_zh: NNV通常导致鱼类幼体或稚鱼大量死亡，但对于石斑鱼，即使是成鱼阶段也对NNV感染高度易感。
text_en: NNV usually causes mass mortality in fish larvae or juveniles, but for grouper, even adults are highly susceptible to NNV infection.
outcome: 死亡率与生长阶段易感性

quote: However, no abnormal clinical signs were observed even at 15 days p.i. (data not shown).
statement: 然而，即使在感染后15天也未观察到异常临床症状。
text_zh: 然而，即使在感染后15天也未观察到异常临床症状。
text_en: However, no abnormal clinical signs were observed even at 15 days post-infection.

quote: Choline chloride (50% purity) was added to create six dietary choline supplementation concentrations: 0.0 mg/kg (P0), 400 mg/kg (P1), 800 mg/kg (P2), 1600 mg/kg (P3), 3200 mg/kg (P4), and 6400 mg/kg (P5).
statement: 氯化胆碱被添加以创建六种不同的膳食胆碱补充浓度。
text_zh: 氯化胆碱被添加以创建六种不同的膳食胆碱补充浓度。
text_en: Choline chloride was added to create six different dietary choline supplementation concentrations.

quote: Specifically, 20% casein was added to meet the protein and amino acid requirements of Chinese perch.
statement: 具体而言，添加了20%的酪蛋白以满足鳜鱼的蛋白质和氨基酸需求。
text_zh: 具体而言，添加了20%的酪蛋白以满足鳜鱼的蛋白质和氨基酸需求。
text_en: Specifically, 20% casein was added to meet the protein and amino acid requirements of mandarin fish.

quote: with 20 fish per tank. There were three replicate tanks for each experimental group
statement: 每个水箱放置20条鱼，每个实验组有三个重复水箱。
text_zh: 每个水箱放置20条鱼，每个实验组有三个重复水箱。
text_en: 20 fish were placed in each tank, with three replicate tanks per experimental group.

quote: Fish were fed twice daily (9:00 and 17:00) to apparent satiation, with feed ration adjusted to 3–5% of total biomass
statement: 每天两次（9:00和17:00）投喂至表观饱食，饲料量调整为总生物量的3-5%。
text_zh: 每天两次（9:00和17:00）投喂至表观饱食，饲料量调整为总生物量的3-5%。
text_en: Fed to apparent satiation twice daily (at 9:00 and 17:00), with feed amount adjusted to 3-5% of total biomass.

quote: and 33–50% of daily water exchanged.
statement: 每日换水量为33-50%。
text_zh: 每日换水量为33-50%。
text_en: The daily water exchange rate is 33-50%.

quote: the water quality was adjusted to maintain dissolved oxygen at 9.0 ± 0.2 mg/L, temperature at 19–24 °C, and pH at 7.8–8.1
statement: 调节水质以维持溶解氧在9.0 ± 0.2 mg/L，温度在19–24 °C，pH值在7.8–8.1。
text_zh: 调节水质以维持溶解氧在9.0 ± 0.2 mg/L，温度在19–24 °C，pH值在7.8–8.1。
text_en: Adjust water quality to maintain dissolved oxygen at 9.0 ± 0.2 mg/L, temperature at 19–24 °C, and pH at 7.8–8.1.

quote: An additional six fish per experimental group (two fish from each of the 3 tanks) were anesthetized, rinsed superficially with 0.9% physiological saline, and dissected on ice using sterile surgical scissors.
statement: 另外每组六条鱼被麻醉，用0.9%生理盐水表面冲洗，并在冰上使用无菌手术剪刀解剖。
text_zh: 另外每组六条鱼被麻醉，用0.9%生理盐水表面冲洗，并在冰上使用无菌手术剪刀解剖。
text_en: Additionally, six fish per group were anesthetized, surface-rinsed with 0.9% saline, and dissected on ice using sterile surgical scissors.
intervention_record: 疫苗接种或采样前麻醉

quote: A previous study has demonstrated that dietary choline supplementation at 770–1082 mg/kg significantly increased the feed intake, weight gain rate, and feed efficiency of grass carp ( Ctenopharyngodon idella ), as well as elevating its muscle protein, lipid, and amino acid content [ 13 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，在草鱼日粮中添加770-1082 mg/kg的胆碱显著增加了采食量、增重率和饲料效率，并提高了肌肉中的蛋白质、脂质和氨基酸含量。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，在草鱼日粮中添加770-1082 mg/kg的胆碱显著增加了采食量、增重率和饲料效率，并提高了肌肉中的蛋白质、脂质和氨基酸含量。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that adding 770-1082 mg/kg of choline to the grass carp diet significantly increased feed intake, weight gain rate, and feed efficiency, and improved protein, lipid, and amino acid content in muscle.

quote: Dietary choline supplementation can enhance the synthesis of acetylcholine, stimulate acetylcholine receptors, elevate cerebral acetylcholine levels, activate the feeding center, and increase the feed intake of fish, thereby improving their energy provision and growth [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ].
statement: 膳食胆碱补充可以增强乙酰胆碱的合成，刺激乙酰胆碱受体，提高大脑乙酰胆水平，激活摄食中枢，增加鱼类采食量，从而改善其能量供应和生长。
text_zh: 膳食胆碱补充可以增强乙酰胆碱的合成，刺激乙酰胆碱受体，提高大脑乙酰胆水平，激活摄食中枢，增加鱼类采食量，从而改善其能量供应和生长。
text_en: Dietary choline supplementation can enhance acetylcholine synthesis, stimulate acetylcholine receptors, increase brain acetylcholine levels, activate the feeding center, and increase fish feed intake, thereby improving their energy supply and growth.

quote: Only the P2 group showed a significantly higher FR than that of the P0 group ( p 0.05).
statement: 仅P2组的采食量（FR）显著高于P0组。
text_zh: 仅P2组的采食量（FR）显著高于P0组。
text_en: Only the feed intake (FR) of the P2 group was significantly higher than that of the P0 group.

quote: Compared to the P0 group, PER and PRV significantly increased in the P1, P2, P3, and P4 groups, but FCR significantly decreased in the P2, P3, and P4 groups ( p 0.05).
statement: 与P0组相比，P1、P2、P3和P4组的蛋白质效率比（PER）和蛋白质保留值（PRV）显著增加，但P2、P3和P4组的饲料系数（FCR）显著降低。
text_zh: 与P0组相比，P1、P2、P3和P4组的蛋白质效率比（PER）和蛋白质保留值（PRV）显著增加，但P2、P3和P4组的饲料系数（FCR）显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the P0 group, the protein efficiency ratio (PER) and protein retention value (PRV) significantly increased in the P1, P2, P3, and P4 groups, but the feed conversion ratio (FCR) significantly decreased in the P2, P3, and P4 groups.

quote: However, the P5 group showed markedly lower SGR, PER, and PRV than those of the P0 group ( p 0.05).
statement: 然而，P5组的特定生长率（SGR）、蛋白质效率比（PER）和蛋白质保留值（PRV）显著低于P0组。
text_zh: 然而，P5组的特定生长率（SGR）、蛋白质效率比（PER）和蛋白质保留值（PRV）显著低于P0组。
text_en: However, the specific growth rate (SGR), protein efficiency ratio (PER), and protein retention value (PRV) of the P5 group were significantly lower than those of the P0 group.
counterevidence: 高剂量组（P5）生长指标下降

quote: Similarly, PRV exhibited a positive correlation (R 2 = 0.96) with choline supplementation (0–800 mg/kg) and a negative correlation (R 2 = 0.97) with choline supplementation at elevated concentrations (1600–6400 mg/kg) ( Figure 1 B).
statement: 蛋白质效率值(PRV)在0–800 mg/kg范围内与胆碱补充呈正相关，而在较高浓度(1600–6400 mg/kg)时呈负相关。
text_zh: 蛋白质效率值(PRV)在0–800 mg/kg范围内与胆碱补充呈正相关，而在较高浓度(1600–6400 mg/kg)时呈负相关。
text_en: The protein efficiency ratio (PER) is positively correlated with choline supplementation in the range of 0–800 mg/kg, and negatively correlated at higher concentrations (1600–6400 mg/kg).
counterevidence: 高浓度胆碱补充导致PRV下降

quote: Compared to the P0 group, the expression levels of the orexigenic gene agrp in the P1, P2, and P3 groups were significantly higher ( p 0.05), while there was a significant decrease in the P5 group ( p 0.05) and no significant change in the P4 group ( p 0.05).
statement: 与P0组相比，P1、P2和P3组的促食欲基因agrp表达水平显著升高，而P5组显著降低，P4组无显著变化。
text_zh: 与P0组相比，P1、P2和P3组的促食欲基因agrp表达水平显著升高，而P5组显著降低，P4组无显著变化。
text_en: Compared to the P0 group, the expression levels of the appetite-stimulating gene agrp were significantly increased in the P1, P2, and P3 groups, significantly decreased in the P5 group, and showed no significant change in the P4 group.
outcome: 摄食行为相关基因表达

quote: No significant difference was found in the expression level of the orexigenic gene npy among all groups ( p 0.05).
statement: 所有组间促食欲基因npy的表达水平均无显著差异。
text_zh: 所有组间促食欲基因npy的表达水平均无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in the expression levels of the appetite-stimulating gene npy among all groups.
outcome: 摄食行为相关基因表达

quote: The expression levels of the anorexigenic gene cart had no significant change in the P1, P2, P3, and P4 groups compared to the P0 group ( p 0.05), while a significant increase in the cart gene expression level was found in the P5 group ( p 0.05).
statement: 与P0组相比，P1、P2、P3和P4组的抑食欲基因cart表达水平无显著变化，而P5组的cart基因表达水平显著增加。
text_zh: 与P0组相比，P1、P2、P3和P4组的抑食欲基因cart表达水平无显著变化，而P5组的cart基因表达水平显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the P0 group, there was no significant change in the expression level of the anorexigenic gene cart in the P1, P2, P3 and P4 groups, while the expression level of the cart gene in the P5 group increased significantly.
outcome: 摄食行为相关基因表达

quote: Extensive research has confirmed that choline supplementation in fish feed promoted lipid catabolism, reduced lipid deposition, and prevented nutritional fatty liver formation; thus, choline is considered a vital anti-fatty liver factor [ 9 , 22 , 23 ].
statement: 广泛的研究证实，鱼类饲料中的胆碱补充促进了脂质分解代谢，减少了脂质沉积，并预防了营养性脂肪肝的形成。
text_zh: 广泛的研究证实，鱼类饲料中的胆碱补充促进了脂质分解代谢，减少了脂质沉积，并预防了营养性脂肪肝的形成。
text_en: Extensive research has confirmed that choline supplementation in fish feed promotes lipid catabolism, reduces lipid deposition, and prevents the formation of nutritional fatty liver.

quote: For instance, dietary supplementation of 603–1512 mg/kg choline significantly reduced the hepatic lipid content in orange-spotted grouper ( Epinephelus coioides ) [ 24 ].
statement: 例如，在棕点石斑鱼饲料中补充603-1512 mg/kg的胆碱显著降低了肝脏脂质含量。
text_zh: 例如，在棕点石斑鱼饲料中补充603-1512 mg/kg的胆碱显著降低了肝脏脂质含量。
text_en: For example, supplementing choline at 603-1512 mg/kg in the diet of brown-marbled grouper significantly reduced liver lipid content.

quote: Conversely, choline deficiency induced multiple undesirable disorders in fish, including appetite suppression, growth retardation, and hepatic lipid dysregulation, as reported in grass carp, yellow catfish ( Pelteobagrus fulvidraco ), and pacu ( Piaractus mesopotamicus ) [ 25 , 26 , 27 ].
statement: 相反，据报道，草鱼、黄颡鱼和淡水白鲳中的胆碱缺乏会导致多种不良障碍，包括食欲抑制、生长迟缓和肝脏脂质失调。
text_zh: 相反，据报道，草鱼、黄颡鱼和淡水白鲳中的胆碱缺乏会导致多种不良障碍，包括食欲抑制、生长迟缓和肝脏脂质失调。
text_en: Conversely, choline deficiency in grass carp, yellow catfish, and pacu has been reported to cause multiple adverse disorders, including appetite suppression, growth retardation, and hepatic lipid dysregulation.

population.species: 草鱼、黄颡鱼 (Pelteobagrus fulvidraco)、淡水白鲳 (Piaractus mesopotamicus)

outcome: 摄食行为、生长及肝脏健康

quote: In addition, 800 mg/kg of choline supplementation significantly improved the FR of Chinese perch ( p 0.05).
statement: 此外，800 mg/kg的胆碱补充显著改善了鳜鱼的摄食率（FR）。
text_zh: 此外，800 mg/kg的胆碱补充显著改善了鳜鱼的摄食率（FR）。
text_en: In addition, choline supplementation at 800 mg/kg significantly improved the feeding rate (FR) of mandarin fish.

quote: These findings are consistent with a previous study on grass carp, which reported that 385–1795 mg/kg of choline supplementation improved the feed intake (FI) of grass carp, which had a strong positive correlation with WGR and feed efficiency [ 13 ].
statement: 先前的草鱼研究报告称，385–1795 mg/kg的胆碱补充改善了草鱼的采食量（FI），且与体重增长率和饲料效率呈强正相关。
text_zh: 先前的草鱼研究报告称，385–1795 mg/kg的胆碱补充改善了草鱼的采食量（FI），且与体重增长率和饲料效率呈强正相关。
text_en: Previous grass carp research reports that choline supplementation at 385–1795 mg/kg improved feed intake (FI) in grass carp, and was strongly positively correlated with weight gain rate and feed efficiency.

quote: Similarly, Wu et al. observed that 607–1820 mg/kg of choline supplementation improved the FBW, SGR, PRV, FI, and intestinal protease activity of common carp ( Cyprinus carpio ) [ 39 ].
statement: Wu等人观察到，607–1820 mg/kg的胆碱补充改善了鲤鱼的终末体重、特定生长率、蛋白质相对值、采食量和肠道蛋白酶活性。
text_zh: Wu等人观察到，607–1820 mg/kg的胆碱补充改善了鲤鱼的终末体重、特定生长率、蛋白质相对值、采食量和肠道蛋白酶活性。
text_en: Wu et al. observed that choline supplementation at 607–1820 mg/kg improved final body weight, specific growth rate, relative protein value, feed intake, and intestinal protease activity in common carp.

quote: Many studies have indicated that choline could not only promote the feeding behavior of fish by modulating the expression of orexigenic genes but also improve their digestive capacity by increasing the secretion of intestinal enzymes [ 41 , 42 , 43 ], which could be part of the reason for the improvements in the growth performance and feeding of Chinese perch in this study.
statement: 许多研究表明，胆碱不仅可以通过调节食欲基因的表达来促进鱼类的摄食行为，还可以通过增加肠道酶的分泌来提高其消化能力，这可能是本研究中鳜鱼生长性能和摄食改善的部分原因。
text_zh: 许多研究表明，胆碱不仅可以通过调节食欲基因的表达来促进鱼类的摄食行为，还可以通过增加肠道酶的分泌来提高其消化能力，这可能是本研究中鳜鱼生长性能和摄食改善的部分原因。
text_en: Many studies have shown that choline can not only promote feeding behavior in fish by regulating the expression of appetite genes, but also improve their digestive capacity by increasing intestinal enzyme secretion; this may be part of the reason for the improved growth performance and feeding in mandarin fish in this study.

quote: These results suggested that excessive choline supplementation (3200 and 6400 mg/kg) disrupted appetite regulation and nutrient assimilation, ultimately decreasing the growth performance of Chinese perch.
statement: 结果表明过量的胆碱补充（3200和6400 mg/kg）破坏了食欲调节和营养吸收，最终降低了鳜鱼的生长性能。
text_zh: 结果表明过量的胆碱补充（3200和6400 mg/kg）破坏了食欲调节和营养吸收，最终降低了鳜鱼的生长性能。
text_en: The results showed that excessive choline supplementation (3200 and 6400 mg/kg) disrupted appetite regulation and nutrient absorption, ultimately reducing the growth performance of mandarin fish.

quote: Choline-induced improvements in the feed intake of fish are associated with the modulation of appetite and energy metabolism [ 42 ].
statement: 胆碱引起的鱼类摄食量改善与食欲和能量代谢的调节有关。
text_zh: 胆碱引起的鱼类摄食量改善与食欲和能量代谢的调节有关。
text_en: The improvement in fish feed intake caused by choline is related to the regulation of appetite and energy metabolism.

quote: In this study, choline supplementation (800 mg/kg) significantly increased FR ( p 0.05).
statement: 在本研究中，添加800 mg/kg的胆碱显著增加了采食率（FR）。
text_zh: 在本研究中，添加800 mg/kg的胆碱显著增加了采食率（FR）。
text_en: In this study, the addition of 800 mg/kg choline significantly increased feed intake rate (FR).

quote: In addition, 400–1600 mg/kg of choline supplementation was found to up-regulate agrp gene expression in the brain ( p 0.05), indicating that choline could enhance the feeding behavior of Chinese perch by stimulating agrp gene expression, thereby improving their growth performance.
statement: 此外，发现400–1600 mg/kg的胆碱补充上调了大脑中的agrp基因表达，表明胆碱可以通过刺激agrp基因表达来增强鳜鱼的摄食行为，从而改善其生长性能。
text_zh: 此外，发现400–1600 mg/kg的胆碱补充上调了大脑中的agrp基因表达，表明胆碱可以通过刺激agrp基因表达来增强鳜鱼的摄食行为，从而改善其生长性能。
text_en: In addition, it was found that choline supplementation at 400–1600 mg/kg upregulated agrp gene expression in the brain, indicating that choline can enhance feeding behavior in mandarin fish by stimulating agrp gene expression, thereby improving their growth performance.

quote: It has been reported that when the added choline exceeded the optimal level, the growth performance of fish could be reduced.
statement: 据报道，当添加的胆碱超过最佳水平时，鱼类的生长性能可能会降低。
text_zh: 据报道，当添加的胆碱超过最佳水平时，鱼类的生长性能可能会降低。
text_en: It is reported that fish growth performance may decrease when choline addition exceeds optimal levels.

quote: For example, 4029 mg/kg of choline supplementation decreased FW and SGR in the orange-spotted grouper [ 24 ], while 20,000 mg/kg of choline supplementation decreased the growth performance and survival rate of the hybrid grouper [ 19 ].
statement: 例如，4029 mg/kg的胆碱补充降低了橙点石斑鱼的终重和特定生长率，而20,000 mg/kg的胆碱补充降低了杂交石斑鱼的生长性能和存活率。
text_zh: 例如，4029 mg/kg的胆碱补充降低了橙点石斑鱼的终重和特定生长率，而20,000 mg/kg的胆碱补充降低了杂交石斑鱼的生长性能和存活率。

population.species: 橙点石斑鱼; 杂交石斑鱼

quote: Similar negative effects of high-level dietary choline supplementation have been illustrated in Senegalese sole ( Solea senegalensis ) and grass carp [ 13 , 48 ].
statement: 高水平膳食胆碱补充在塞内加尔鳎和草鱼中也显示出类似的负面影响。
text_zh: 高水平膳食胆碱补充在塞内加尔鳎和草鱼中也显示出类似的负面影响。
text_en: High-level dietary choline supplementation also showed similar negative effects in Senegalese sole and grass carp.

quote: In this study, 3200 mg/kg of choline supplementation significantly up-regulated the anorexigenic gene pomc ( p 0.05).
statement: 在本研究中，3200 mg/kg的胆碱补充显著上调了厌食基因pomc的表达。
text_zh: 在本研究中，3200 mg/kg的胆碱补充显著上调了厌食基因pomc的表达。
text_en: In this study, choline supplementation at 3200 mg/kg significantly upregulated the expression of the anorexia gene pomc.

quote: Also, 6400 mg/kg of choline supplementation increased the expression of the anorexigenic gene cart ( p 0.05) while suppressing the expression of the orexigenic gene agrp ( p 0.05).
statement: 此外，6400 mg/kg的胆碱补充增加了厌食基因cart的表达，同时抑制了促食基因agrp的表达。
text_zh: 此外，6400 mg/kg的胆碱补充增加了厌食基因cart的表达，同时抑制了促食基因agrp的表达。
text_en: In addition, choline supplementation at 6400 mg/kg increased the expression of the anorexigenic gene cart while inhibiting the expression of the orexigenic gene agrp.

quote: The model proved that the oxygen consumption rate, tail beating frequency, and respiratory rate increased with the increase in swimming speed.
statement: 模型证明耗氧率、尾鳍摆动频率和呼吸频率随游泳速度的增加而增加。
text_zh: 模型证明耗氧率、尾鳍摆动频率和呼吸频率随游泳速度的增加而增加。
text_en: The model demonstrated that oxygen consumption rate, tail fin beat frequency and respiratory frequency increase with increasing swimming speed.
outcome: 生理应激指标（耗氧、呼吸）

quote: The higher the temperature, the more significant the changes were.
statement: 温度越高，上述生理指标的变化越显著。
text_zh: 温度越高，上述生理指标的变化越显著。
text_en: The higher the temperature, the more significant the changes in the aforementioned physiological indicators.

quote: The results showed that water temperature significantly affected the swimming characteristics of juvenile Siniperca knerii Garman.
statement: 结果表明水温显著影响鳜幼鱼的游泳特征。
text_zh: 结果表明水温显著影响鳜幼鱼的游泳特征。
text_en: The results showed that water temperature significantly affected the swimming characteristics of juvenile mandarin fish.

quote: Broken-line analysis indicated that the optimal choline supplementation level for Chinese perch is 788.38 mg/kg based on SGR and 851.04 mg/kg based on PRV.
statement: 折线分析表明，基于特定生长率的鳜鱼最佳胆碱补充水平为788.38 mg/kg，基于蛋白质保留值的最佳水平为851.04 mg/kg。
text_zh: 折线分析表明，基于特定生长率的鳜鱼最佳胆碱补充水平为788.38 mg/kg，基于蛋白质保留值的最佳水平为851.04 mg/kg。
text_en: Breakpoint analysis indicated that the optimal choline supplementation level for mandarin fish was 788.38 mg/kg based on specific growth rate, and 851.04 mg/kg based on protein retention value.

quote:
ation of many cascade hydropower sta­
tions and large reservoirs have been built in the main­
stream of the Yuanshui River, and the connectivity of the
river has been blocked. They cause great changes in the
ecological environment factors of the Yuanshui River, such
as flow velocity, water temperature, and other hydrological
conditions, which have seriously affected the life activities
and reproduction of fish in the Yuan River basin.
statement: 梯级水电站和大型水库的建设阻断了河流连通性，导致流速、水温等生态因子发生巨大变化，严重影响了鱼类的生活活动和繁殖。
text_zh: 梯级水电站和大型水库的建设阻断了河流连通性，导致流速、水温等生态因子发生巨大变化，严重影响了鱼类的生活活动和繁殖。
text_en: The construction of cascade hydropower stations and large reservoirs has blocked river connectivity, leading to significant changes in ecological factors such as flow velocity and water temperature, which have severely affected the life activities and reproduction of fish.

quote: However, excessive choline supplementation (6400 mg/kg) significantly up-regulated the gene expression of energy stress markers ( lkb1 , ampk , and eef2 ) ( p 0.05), which may be due to the imbalance of energy metabolism in fish caused by the high levels of choline supplementation.
statement: 然而，过量的胆碱补充（6400毫克/千克）显著上调了能量应激标记物（lkb1、ampk和eef2）的基因表达，这可能是由于高剂量胆碱补充导致鱼类能量代谢失衡所致。
text_zh: 然而，过量的胆碱补充（6400毫克/千克）显著上调了能量应激标记物（lkb1、ampk和eef2）的基因表达，这可能是由于高剂量胆碱补充导致鱼类能量代谢失衡所致。
text_en: However, excessive choline supplementation (6400 mg/kg) significantly upregulated the gene expression of energy stress markers (lkb1, ampk and eef2), which may be due to an imbalance in fish energy metabolism caused by high-dose choline supplementation.

quote: and then adapted to the flow rate of 0.5BL for 10min-30min, and then slowly increased the flow rate.
statement: 随后让鱼适应0.5体长/秒的流速10至30分钟，然后缓慢增加流速。
text_zh: 随后让鱼适应0.5体长/秒的流速10至30分钟，然后缓慢增加流速。
text_en: The fish were then acclimated to a flow velocity of 0.5 body lengths/second for 10 to 30 minutes, after which the flow velocity was slowly increased.

quote: The regression relationships between oxygen consump­tion rate (y)and relative critical swimming speed were all significant (P<0.05) for the four temperature groups.
statement: 不同温度组中耗氧率与相对临界游泳速度之间的回归关系均显著。
text_zh: 不同温度组中耗氧率与相对临界游泳速度之间的回归关系均显著。
text_en: The regression relationship between oxygen consumption rate and relative critical swimming speed was significant in all temperature groups.
outcome: 生理代谢与运动能力关系

quote: The regression equations for the four groups of oxygen con­sumption rate and tail beat frequency were all significantly correlated (P<0.05).
statement: 四组耗氧率与尾鳍摆动频率的回归方程均呈显著相关。
text_zh: 四组耗氧率与尾鳍摆动频率的回归方程均呈显著相关。
text_en: The regression equations for oxygen consumption rate and caudal fin beat frequency in all four groups showed significant correlation.
outcome: 生理代谢与运动行为关系

quote: To reduce the stress response of the fish, the captured wild fish were acclimated for 7d before starting the experiment.
statement: 在实验开始前对捕获的野生鱼进行7天的驯化以减少其应激反应。
text_zh: 在实验开始前对捕获的野生鱼进行7天的驯化以减少其应激反应。
text_en: Captured wild fish were acclimated for 7 days before the start of the experiment to reduce their stress response.

quote: During the period, common commercial fish pellet feed was fed.
statement: 在驯化期间投喂普通的商业鱼颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 在驯化期间投喂普通的商业鱼颗粒饲料。
text_en: During the acclimation period, ordinary commercial fish pellet feed was fed.

quote: Constant temperature (20.0±1.0°C), natural photoperiod, sufficient oxygen supply(≥6.5mg/L), and pH (7.3±0.1) were maintained.
statement: 维持恒温（20.0±1.0°C）、自然光周期、充足的氧气供应（≥6.5mg/L）和pH值（7.3±0.1）。
text_zh: 维持恒温（20.0±1.0°C）、自然光周期、充足的氧气供应（≥6.5mg/L）和pH值（7.3±0.1）。
text_en: Maintain constant temperature (20.0±1.0°C), natural photoperiod, sufficient oxygen supply (≥6.5mg/L) and pH value (7.3±0.1).

quote: the temperature was increased by thermostatic heating rod and decreased by ice mass.
statement: 使用恒温加热棒升高水温，使用冰块降低水温。
text_zh: 使用恒温加热棒升高水温，使用冰块降低水温。
text_en: Use constant temperature heating rods to raise water temperature, and use ice blocks to lower water temperature.

quote: The water temper­ature was regulated by 1-2℃ every day until the set tem­perature and then adapted to 30 d.
statement: 水温每天调节1-2℃直至设定温度，随后适应30天。
text_zh: 水温每天调节1-2℃直至设定温度，随后适应30天。
text_en: Water temperature is adjusted by 1-2°C per day until the set temperature, followed by a 30-day acclimation period.

quote: Flow velocity was measured with a velocity meter (China, LS300-A), oxygen content in the water was measured with a dissolved oxygen analyzer (Swiss, MettlerSG98-FK2), and a computer-connected cam­era (Sony ILCE-6300) was installed above and to the side of the tank to monitor and test the animals from multiple an­gles.
statement: 使用流速仪测量流速，溶解氧分析仪测量水中含氧量，并安装连接电脑的相机从多角度监测和测试动物。
text_zh: 使用流速仪测量流速，溶解氧分析仪测量水中含氧量，并安装连接电脑的相机从多角度监测和测试动物。
text_en: Flow velocity was measured using a flow meter, dissolved oxygen in the water was measured using a dissolved oxygen analyzer, and cameras connected to computers were installed to monitor and test animals from multiple angles.

quote: The propeller motor power was ad­justed by an external frequency changer to change the ro­tational speed of the propeller, thus creating a circulating water flow with different flow velocities.
statement: 通过外部变频器调节螺旋桨电机功率以改变转速，从而产生不同流速的循环水流。
text_zh: 通过外部变频器调节螺旋桨电机功率以改变转速，从而产生不同流速的循环水流。
text_en: The power of the propeller motor is adjusted via an external variable frequency drive to change the rotation speed, thereby generating circulating water flow at different velocities.

quote: And because of the rectifier, the flow will be relatively smooth and equal.
statement: 由于整流器的作用，水流相对平稳均匀。
text_zh: 由于整流器的作用，水流相对平稳均匀。
text_en: Due to the action of the rectifier, the water flow is relatively stable and uniform.

quote: The dissolved oxygen analyzer monitored the changes in dissolved oxy­gen during fish swimming at different water flows.
statement: 溶解氧分析仪监测了鱼在不同水流速度下游泳时溶解氧的变化。
text_zh: 溶解氧分析仪监测了鱼在不同水流速度下游泳时溶解氧的变化。
text_en: A dissolved oxygen analyzer monitored changes in dissolved oxygen as fish swam at different water flow speeds.

quote: this study found that moderate dietary choline supplementation (400–1600 mg/kg) not only up-regulated the orexigenic gene expressions to promote fish feeding behavior but also enhanced protein synthesis by increasing the expression levels of glycolysis- and lipolysis-related genes and suppressing those of proteolysis-related genes, resulting in an enhanced growth performance of Chinese perch.
statement: 本研究发现，中等剂量的膳食胆碱补充（400–1600 mg/kg）不仅上调食欲基因表达以促进摄食行为，还通过增加糖酵解和脂解相关基因的表达并抑制蛋白水解相关基因的表达来增强蛋白质合成，从而提高了鳜鱼的生长性能。
text_zh: 本研究发现，中等剂量的膳食胆碱补充（400–1600 mg/kg）不仅上调食欲基因表达以促进摄食行为，还通过增加糖酵解和脂解相关基因的表达并抑制蛋白水解相关基因的表达来增强蛋白质合成，从而提高了鳜鱼的生长性能。
text_en: This study found that moderate-dose dietary choline supplementation (400–1600 mg/kg) not only upregulated appetite gene expression to promote feeding behavior, but also enhanced protein synthesis by increasing the expression of glycolysis and lipolysis-related genes and inhibiting the expression of proteolysis-related genes, thereby improving the growth performance of Chinese perch.
